meta.title: BC Practical Exam Scenarios - EMR Trauma Set 2
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice scenarios modeled on EMALB exam format; EMR scope of practice

scenarios.titleEn: Chainsaw Laceration to the Thigh - Tourniquet Plus Junctional Wound Packing
scenarios.titleZh: 链锯致大腿撕裂——止血带联合腹股沟伤口填塞
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1420 hrs. Code 3 to a private woodlot off Sylvester Road, Mission. A 47-year-old male was bucking firewood when the chainsaw kicked back into his left thigh. The caller is his son. Steady cold rain, 6 degrees C. Mission Fire first responders are 6 minutes behind you. Abbotsford Regional Hospital is 26 minutes by road; air ambulance is unavailable because of low cloud.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:20，Code 3 前往米逊（Mission）Sylvester Road 旁的私人林场。一名 47 岁男性在锯柴时链锯回弹，锯到左大腿。报警人是他儿子。持续冷雨，气温 6 摄氏度。米逊消防急救员比你晚 6 分钟到场。阿伯茨福德区域医院（ARH）陆路 26 分钟；因云层过低，直升机救护无法出动。

phases.infoEn: En-route update: the son says there is 'blood everywhere' and that he has cinched a leather belt around his father's leg. Access is a gravel road with a gate at the top and about 40 metres of uneven ground down to the work site.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：儿子说"到处都是血"，并已用一条皮带勒住父亲的腿。进场是一条碎石路，路口有一道门，从门口到作业点还有约 40 米高低不平的地面。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge the call and plan the sequence out loud: tourniquet, wound packing, high-flow oxygen, warmth, early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认出车，并口述计划顺序：止血带、伤口填塞、高流量吸氧、保暖、尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Request fire first responders for the carry-out and extra hands; confirm gate access and a carry route; consider a PCP/ALS intercept given the 26-minute road time
expected.actionZh: 请求消防急救员协助抬运并增派人手；确认大门通行和抬运路线；因陆路 26 分钟，考虑与 PCP/ALS 途中会合

expected.actionEn: Anticipate blood exposure, a running saw, wet uneven ground and cold rain; prepare PPE including eye protection and high-visibility clothing
expected.actionZh: 预判血液暴露、链锯、湿滑不平地面和冷雨；准备个人防护装备，含护目镜与高可视外套

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The gate is open and the son waves you down the slope. The chainsaw is switched off on the ground three metres away with the chain brake engaged. The patient is sitting against a stack of rounds, his left pant leg shredded and soaked. A leather belt has been cinched above the wound but is loose and is controlling nothing. Bright red blood is running into the mud - estimate 800 to 1000 mL lost. Rain, 6 degrees C, uneven slippery footing. One patient. No other hazards.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：大门开着，儿子挥手示意你沿坡下来。链锯已关停，倒在 3 米外，链条制动已锁。患者靠在一堆圆木上坐着，左裤腿被撕烂并被血浸透。伤口上方勒着一条皮带，但很松，完全没有止血作用。鲜红血液正流进泥里——估计已失血 800 至 1000 mL。下雨，6 摄氏度，地面湿滑不平。仅一名患者，无其他危险源。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (saw shut down, blood, slippery slope, cold rain), environment, MOI (chainsaw kickback) and number of patients
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（锯已关停、血液、湿滑坡地、冷雨）、环境、受伤机制（链锯回弹）与患者人数

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection before touching the patient (arterial splash risk)
expected.actionZh: 接触患者前戴手套和护目镜（动脉性喷溅风险）

expected.actionEn: First look from the approach: pale, sweating, anxious adult male, awake, pumping bright red blood from the mid-anterior left thigh
expected.actionZh: 接近途中第一眼：苍白、出汗、焦虑的成年男性，清醒，左大腿前中部搏动性喷出鲜红血液

expected.actionEn: Direct the son and the arriving fire crew: bring the cot to the gate, prepare blankets, plan the 40-metre carry
expected.actionZh: 指挥儿子和到场消防员：把担架床推到大门口、备好毯子、规划 40 米抬运路线

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, pale, shivering, gripping the leg, 'it just jumped back at me'. EXAMINER: This is MAJOR arterial hemorrhage. The belt is ineffective. Direct pressure through dressings slows but does not stop the bleeding. The candidate must apply a commercial windlass tourniquet to the left thigh, high and tight proximal to the wound, over skin, tightened until the bleeding stops and the distal pulse is gone, TIME NOTED, never released. Once the tourniquet is on, a second deep gash in the left groin crease continues to bleed - this is junctional and NOT amenable to a tourniquet: it must be packed with gauze and held with sustained direct pressure, then covered with a pressure dressing. Airway clear, speaking in full sentences. Respirations 24. Right radial pulse 128, weak and thready. Skin pale, cool, clammy. Rapid body survey: no other injuries, no fall, no head or neck involvement, so spinal precautions are NOT indicated. SpO2 92% on room air, 97% on 15 L. UNSTABLE: hemorrhage requiring a tourniquet and wound packing, plus shock signs.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、苍白、发抖，紧抓着腿说"锯子突然弹回来了"。考官：这是大动脉性出血。皮带无效。隔敷料直接加压能减缓但无法止住出血。考生必须在左大腿伤口近端高位紧上一条商用绞棒式止血带，直接贴皮肤，收紧至出血停止且远端脉搏消失，记录时间，此后绝不放松。止血带上好后，左侧腹股沟褶处还有一道深裂伤持续出血——该处属于交界区，无法上止血带：必须用纱布填塞并持续直接加压，再加盖加压敷料。气道通畅，能整句说话。呼吸 24。右桡动脉 128、细弱。皮肤苍白、湿冷。快速查体：无其他损伤、无坠落、头颈未受累，因此没有脊柱固定指征。SpO2 室内空气 92%，15 L 吸氧后 97%。不稳定：需止血带与填塞的大出血合并休克征象。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert（清醒）

expected.actionEn: Remove the ineffective belt and apply a commercial windlass tourniquet high and tight proximal to the thigh wound; tighten until bleeding stops; NOTE THE TIME; never release
expected.actionZh: 取下无效的皮带，在大腿伤口近端高位紧上商用绞棒式止血带；收紧至出血停止；记录时间；此后绝不放松

expected.actionEn: Pack the junctional groin wound with gauze and hold sustained direct pressure, then apply a pressure dressing - a tourniquet cannot be used there (never pack neck, chest or abdomen)
expected.actionZh: 对腹股沟交界区伤口用纱布填塞并持续直接加压，再加盖加压敷料——该部位无法使用止血带（颈部、胸部、腹部禁止填塞）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate, depth and effort
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸的频率、深度和费力程度

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - weak thready radial pulse - and recognize hypovolemic shock
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——桡动脉细弱——并识别低血容量性休克

expected.actionEn: Complete the rapid body survey for other injuries and confirm that spinal precautions are not indicated
expected.actionZh: 完成快速查体排查其他损伤，并确认无脊柱固定指征

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: pale, cool and clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、湿冷

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather mask for shock
expected.actionZh: 因休克给予 15 L 非再吸入面罩高流量吸氧

expected.actionEn: Lay the patient supine, get him off the wet ground onto insulation, remove wet clothing and cover with blankets
expected.actionZh: 让患者仰卧，用隔垫把他与湿地面隔开，脱去湿衣物并盖毯保暖

expected.actionEn: Bandage the thigh wound once the hemorrhage is controlled
expected.actionZh: 出血控制后包扎大腿伤口

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Hemorrhage requiring a tourniquet AND wound packing, plus cool pale clammy skin from shock = UNSTABLE, RTC. Ready to load within 15 minutes. The carry-out over 40 metres of uneven wet ground needs the fire crew and a scoop or basket stretcher; keep him supine, flat and warm. With a 26-minute road time, request a PCP/ALS intercept but do not delay departure for it.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。需止血带且需填塞的大出血，加上休克所致的湿冷苍白皮肤＝不稳定，RTC。15 分钟内打包完毕可装载。40 米湿滑不平地面的抬运需要消防员和铲式或篮式担架；全程保持仰卧、平放、保暖。陆路 26 分钟，可请求 PCP/ALS 途中会合，但不得为等待会合而延误出发。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and move with a visible sense of urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并以明显的紧迫感行动

expected.actionEn: Packaged and ready to be lifted onto the cot within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内打包完毕、可抬上担架床

expected.actionEn: Direct the fire crew for the carry-out, lighting and blankets, and request the intercept without delaying departure
expected.actionZh: 指挥消防员完成抬运、照明与保暖，并在不延误出发的前提下请求途中会合

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE (or while the fire crew prepares the carry). ACTOR: he was limbing a wet alder at full throttle when the tip caught and the saw kicked back into his thigh, about five minutes before the 911 call. He was not wearing chaps. He did not fall, did not hit his head, and never lost consciousness. Pain was 9/10 before the tourniquet, now 7/10. PMHx: high blood pressure, left knee arthroscopy in 2018. Meds: ramipril. Allergies: none known. LOI: sandwich and coffee at 1300. He thinks his last tetanus shot was about ten years ago.
phases.infoZh: 途中（或消防员准备抬运时）。患者演员：他在全油门修剪一棵湿桤木时锯尖被卡住，链锯回弹锯进大腿，大约在报警前 5 分钟。当时没穿防护裤。没有摔倒、没有撞到头、全程没有昏迷。上止血带前疼痛 9/10，现在 7/10。既往史：高血压，2018 年做过左膝关节镜。用药：雷米普利（ramipril）。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：13:00 一个三明治和咖啡。他记得上一次破伤风疫苗大约是十年前。

expected.actionEn: Confirm the chief complaint
expected.actionZh: 确认主诉

expected.actionEn: HxC/C: mechanism, exact time of injury, saw contact points, protective equipment, blood lost before arrival, any fall or LOC
expected.actionZh: 现病史：受伤机制、准确受伤时间、锯片接触部位、防护装备、到场前失血量、有无摔倒或昏迷

expected.actionEn: Pain score before and after the tourniquet
expected.actionZh: 上止血带前后的疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx: hypertension, previous knee surgery, tetanus status
expected.actionZh: 既往史：高血压、既往膝部手术、破伤风免疫状态

expected.actionEn: Medications: ramipril (an ACE inhibitor may blunt the tachycardic response to blood loss)
expected.actionZh: 用药史：雷米普利（ACE 抑制剂可能钝化失血时的心率代偿反应）

expected.actionEn: Allergies: none known
expected.actionZh: 过敏史：无已知过敏

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后进食时间

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (baseline, tourniquet on, in the ambulance): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 88/56; pulse 128 weak regular; respirations 24 regular; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 97% on 15 L NRB; temperature 35.4 C (cold wet exposure plus shock - temperature IS indicated here); BGL not indicated (GCS 15, not diabetic). Priority patient: repeat the full set every 7-8 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（基线，止血带已上，车上测得）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 88/56；脉搏 128 细弱规则；呼吸 24 规则；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 非再吸入面罩下 97%；体温 35.4 摄氏度（湿冷暴露合并休克——此处体温有指征）；血糖无指征（GCS 15、非糖尿病）。危重患者：每 7-8 分钟复测一组完整生命体征。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated
expected.actionZh: GCS 并报出三个分项

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation on the arm
expected.actionZh: 在手臂上听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、强度和节律

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and effort
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和费力程度

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on (colour, temperature, moisture)
expected.actionZh: 动手评估皮肤（颜色、温度、湿度）

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 on the uninjured side, recorded with the oxygen delivery device
expected.actionZh: 在健侧测 SpO2，并连同给氧方式一起记录

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated because of cold wet exposure and shock
expected.actionZh: 体温——因湿冷暴露合并休克而有指征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, kept brief because the patient is unstable. ACTOR: general - felt faint when he stood up; CNS - no LOC, no headache; respiratory - nothing; cardiovascular - heart is pounding; GI/GU - felt sick once, no vomiting; integumentary - the thigh and groin wounds only; musculoskeletal - cannot bear weight on the left leg; endocrine - nothing; EENT - nothing.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中进行，因患者不稳定而从简。患者演员：整体——站起来时觉得快晕倒；中枢神经——无昏迷、无头痛；呼吸——无异常；心血管——心跳很重；消化/泌尿——恶心过一次、未呕吐；皮肤——仅大腿和腹股沟伤口；肌肉骨骼——左腿无法负重；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

phases.infoEn: EN-ROUTE head-to-toe: head and neck normal, no injury above the clavicles; chest clear with equal air entry at six sites; abdomen soft and non-tender; back checked during the transfer - no injury; upper extremities normal; lower extremities - windlass tourniquet on the proximal left thigh with the time written on it, packed and dressed groin wound that is staying dry, no pulse in the left foot (expected below the tourniquet), left foot cool, right leg entirely normal with a strong pedal pulse.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚检查：头颈正常，锁骨以上无损伤；胸部听诊清晰，6 个部位进气对称；腹部柔软无压痛；转移时检查背部——无损伤；上肢正常；下肢——左大腿近端绞棒式止血带在位并已写上时间，腹股沟伤口填塞加压后敷料保持干燥，左足无脉（止血带远端的预期表现），左足发凉，右腿完全正常、足背动脉搏动有力。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examination
expected.actionZh: 头颈部查体

expected.actionEn: Chest examination with auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdominal examination
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back examination during the transfer
expected.actionZh: 转移过程中检查背部

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities
expected.actionZh: 上肢查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities: tourniquet site and time, packed groin dressing, compare distal circulation both feet
expected.actionZh: 下肢：止血带部位与时间、腹股沟填塞敷料、双足远端循环对比

phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Wound Care sequence for this call: direct pressure first, then a tourniquet proximal to the thigh wound because pressure failed, then packing of the groin wound because that site cannot take a tourniquet, then bandaging. Hypovolemia management: supine, high-flow oxygen, aggressive warmth (remove wet clothing, dry him, blankets, turn the ambulance heat up) because cold worsens bleeding. Analgesia: shock is a listed CAUTION for Entonox - withhold it and document the reason. Acetaminophen and ibuprofen by mouth are not appropriate in a shocked patient heading straight to the operating room. EMR SCOPE NOTE: there is no IV, no fluid bolus and no TXA at the EMR level - the answer to ongoing bleeding is a correct tourniquet, correct packing, warmth and speed.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。本例伤口处理顺序：先直接加压；加压无效后在大腿伤口近端上止血带；腹股沟处无法上止血带，故行伤口填塞；最后包扎。低血容量处理：仰卧、高流量吸氧、积极保暖（脱去湿衣、擦干、盖毯、调高车内暖气），因为低体温会加重出血。镇痛：休克是 Entonox 的"慎用"情形——暂不给并记录理由；口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬对即将进手术室的休克患者也不合适。EMR 范围提示：EMR 层级没有静脉通路、没有补液、没有 TXA——面对持续出血，答案是止血带上得正确、填塞做得正确、保暖到位、转运够快。

expected.actionEn: Wound management skill: windlass tourniquet placed high and tight over skin, tightened until bleeding stops, time written on the tourniquet and never released
expected.actionZh: 伤口处理技能：绞棒式止血带高位紧贴皮肤上好、收紧至出血停止、时间写在止血带上且此后绝不放松

expected.actionEn: Wound management skill: pack the junctional groin wound firmly down to the bleeding source, hold pressure for three minutes, then apply a pressure dressing over the packing
expected.actionZh: 伤口处理技能：把腹股沟交界区伤口填塞至出血源、持续加压 3 分钟，再在填塞物上加盖加压敷料

expected.actionEn: Execute hypovolemia management: supine, high-flow oxygen, warmth, rapid transport
expected.actionZh: 执行低血容量处理：仰卧、高流量吸氧、保暖、快速转运

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that Entonox is withheld because shock is a listed caution, and document the rationale
expected.actionZh: 口述因休克属于慎用情形而暂不给 Entonox，并记录理由

expected.actionEn: Active rewarming: remove wet clothing, dry the patient, blankets, ambulance heat up - cold worsens bleeding
expected.actionZh: 主动复温：脱去湿衣物、擦干身体、覆盖毯子、调高车内暖气——低体温会加重出血

phases.infoEn: Reassess the ABCs, the tourniquet and both dressings after every move and every few minutes. The packed dressing must stay dry; if it soaks through, add packing and more pressure on top - do NOT remove the original packing to look at the wound. Set 2 (en route, 8 minutes after set 1, warmed and on oxygen): GCS 15; BP 92/60; pulse 120 weak regular; respirations 22; skin pale and cool but no longer clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 98% on 15 L; temperature 35.8 C. Bleeding remains controlled.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后以及每隔数分钟复评 ABC、止血带和两处敷料。填塞后的敷料必须保持干燥；若被浸透，应在其上追加填塞和加压——绝不可为了"看一眼伤口"而取出原有填塞物。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组后 8 分钟，已保暖并吸氧）：GCS 15；血压 92/60；脉搏 120 细弱规则；呼吸 22；皮肤苍白发凉但已不再湿黏；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 下 98%；体温 35.8 摄氏度。出血持续控制中。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs plus the tourniquet and both dressings after each move
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后复评 ABC 以及止血带和两处敷料

expected.actionEn: Second complete set of vitals within 7-8 minutes and interpret the trend out loud
expected.actionZh: 7-8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读变化趋势

expected.actionEn: Never loosen or release the tourniquet and never remove the packing en route
expected.actionZh: 途中绝不放松或松解止血带，绝不取出填塞物

expected.actionEn: Keep monitoring temperature and continue rewarming
expected.actionZh: 持续监测体温并继续复温

phases.infoEn: En-route notification to Abbotsford Regional Hospital: major extremity hemorrhage, tourniquet applied, ETA. The tourniquet time must be stated out loud at hand-off. The PCR is due within 5 minutes and must document both hemorrhage-control sites and the times.

criticalPitfallsEn: Leaving the ineffective belt in place, or delaying the commercial tourniquet while repeating direct pressure that has already failed - failure to control life-threatening hemorrhage, 100%
Loosening or releasing the tourniquet once it is applied, or 'checking' by letting it off - 100%

Trying to control the junctional groin bleed with a second tourniquet instead of packing it, or packing a wound of the neck, chest or abdomen - incorrect intervention detrimental to patient care, 100%
Removing the original packing en route to look at the wound instead of packing and pressing on top of it - 100%
Calling this patient non-RTC, or spending time on a full head-to-toe on scene before the tourniquet is on - transport and call-management deductions plus a missed 15-minute clock
Letting the patient lie on cold wet ground in wet clothing - hypothermia worsens coagulopathy and counts as care that was required but not given
criticalPitfallsZh: 留着无效的皮带不管，或在直接加压已经失败的情况下反复加压而拖延商用止血带——未能控制致命性出血，扣 100%。
止血带上好后又放松、松解，或为"看看还流不流"而松开——扣 100%。
试图在腹股沟交界区再上一条止血带而不做填塞，或对颈部、胸部、腹部伤口做填塞——干预错误并损害患者，扣 100%。
途中为查看伤口而取出原有填塞物，而不是在其上追加填塞和加压——扣 100%。
把该患者判为非 RTC，或在止血带上好之前就在现场做完整的从头到脚检查——转运与整体处置扣分，并错过 15 分钟时限。
让患者穿着湿衣服躺在湿冷地面上——低体温会加重凝血障碍，属于"该做而未做"的照护缺失。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR scope covers everything this patient needs before hospital: commercial tourniquet, junctional wound packing, pressure dressings, high-flow oxygen, supine positioning, aggressive rewarming and a 15-minute package. The out-of-scope temptations here are an IV and a fluid bolus, and TXA - both are PCP-only and neither is an acceptable answer at EMR level. Entonox is within EMR scope but is withheld because shock is a listed caution; say so out loud. If the road time is long, request a PCP/ALS intercept but never delay departure to wait for one.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 本例患者到院前所需的一切处置都在 EMR 授权范围内：商用止血带、交界区伤口填塞、加压敷料、高流量吸氧、仰卧体位、积极复温，以及 15 分钟内完成打包。此处的"超范围诱惑"是建立静脉通路补液和使用 TXA——两者都是 PCP 专属，在 EMR 层级都不是正确答案。Entonox 虽在 EMR 范围内，但因休克属于慎用情形而不给，务必口头说明。若陆路时间长，可请求 PCP/ALS 途中会合，但绝不能为等待会合而延误出发。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route, a 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus to a maximum of 2 litres reassessed every 500 mL targeting a systolic around 90, and TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute (this patient is well inside the 3-hour window and is in shock from blood loss). PCP also completes the Functional Enquiry en route. The hemorrhage control itself does not change - the tourniquet and the packing are still what save this leg and this life.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路、生理盐水 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评、目标收缩压约 90），以及 TXA 2 g 静脉推注 1 分钟（该患者远在 3 小时窗内且为失血性休克）。PCP 还需在途中完成功能问诊。止血本身没有变化——保住这条腿和这条命的仍然是止血带和填塞。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 47-year-old male with a chainsaw laceration to the left mid-anterior thigh sustained at approximately 1415 today, plus a second deep laceration in the left groin crease. He had arterial bleeding that was not controlled by direct pressure. A windlass tourniquet was applied high on the left thigh at 1430 and has not been released; the groin wound is junctional and was packed with gauze at 1433 with a pressure dressing over top, and that dressing has stayed dry. Estimated blood loss on scene is 800 to 1000 millilitres. First vitals were GCS 15, BP 88/56, pulse 128 and weak, respirations 24, skin pale cool clammy, SpO2 97 percent on 15 litres, temperature 35.4; his latest set is BP 92/60, pulse 120, temperature 35.8 after rewarming. He has hypertension and takes ramipril, no known allergies, last ate at 1300, and his last tetanus was about ten years ago. Treatments were the tourniquet, wound packing, high-flow oxygen, supine positioning, removal of wet clothing and active rewarming. Entonox was withheld because he is in shock. He has had no IV and no TXA - I am an EMR.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 47 岁男性，今天约 14:15 被链锯锯伤左大腿前中部，另有一道左腹股沟褶深裂伤。伤后为动脉性出血，直接加压未能控制。14:30 在左大腿高位上绞棒式止血带，此后未松解；腹股沟属交界区，于 14:33 用纱布填塞并加盖加压敷料，该敷料一直保持干燥。现场估计失血 800 至 1000 毫升。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 88/56、脉搏 128 细弱、呼吸 24、皮肤苍白湿冷、SpO2 15 升下 97%、体温 35.4；复温后末组血压 92/60、脉搏 120、体温 35.8。既往高血压，服用雷米普利，无已知过敏，13:00 最后进食，上次破伤风疫苗约在十年前。已做处置：止血带、伤口填塞、高流量吸氧、仰卧体位、脱去湿衣物并主动复温。因处于休克状态未给 Entonox。我是 EMR，未建立静脉通路、未给 TXA。

scenarios.titleEn: House Fire - Burns With Suspected Inhalation Injury
scenarios.titleZh: 住宅火灾——烧伤合并疑似吸入性损伤
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0312 hrs. Code 3 to a basement suite fire on 108 Avenue in Whalley, Surrey. Surrey Fire is on scene with the fire knocked down and has removed one adult female from the suite. Surrey Memorial Hospital is 8 minutes away. Second unit is 14 minutes out.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 03:12，Code 3 前往素里 Whalley 区 108 Avenue 一处地下室套房火灾。素里消防已在现场并已控制火势，从套房内救出一名成年女性。素里纪念医院车程 8 分钟。第二辆救护车还有 14 分钟到达。

phases.infoEn: En-route update: fire command reports one patient only, burns to the face, chest and one arm, breathing on her own but coughing badly. The crew has her in the driveway upwind and has been cooling her with a gentle hose spray.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：消防指挥报告仅一名患者，面部、胸部和一侧手臂烧伤，能自主呼吸但咳嗽剧烈。消防员已把她转移到上风向的车道上，并用软管细水流持续降温。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan out loud: airway first, oxygen, finish 15-20 minutes of cooling then stop and dry, dressings, keep her warm, short transport
expected.actionZh: 确认出车并口述计划：气道优先、给氧、把降温做满 15-20 分钟后停止并擦干、覆盖敷料、保暖、短程转运

expected.actionEn: Ask fire command how long they have already been cooling and whether the suite was a closed space with smoke
expected.actionZh: 向消防指挥询问已经降温了多久，以及套房是否为充满烟雾的密闭空间

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a hot zone, smoke, unstable structure and blood/body fluid exposure; PPE on before approach and stage where fire command directs
expected.actionZh: 预判热区、烟雾、建筑不稳定和体液暴露；接近前穿好个人防护装备，并按消防指挥的指定位置停靠

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Command declares the driveway safe for you; you are NOT to enter the structure. The fire crew has been running cool (not cold) water over her right arm and chest for about 8 minutes. She is sitting upright on a tarp, coughing, with soot around her nose and mouth, singed nasal hairs and eyebrows, and a hoarse voice. Burns: superficial to the face; partial thickness across the anterior trunk (18%) and circumferential partial thickness to the entire right arm (9%) with some full-thickness patches on the forearm. She is wearing a wedding ring, a watch, and a melted synthetic sleeve which is stuck to the forearm in places. Outside temperature 9 degrees C, wet ground. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：指挥宣布车道区域对你安全，你不得进入建筑物内。消防员已用凉水（不是冰水）冲洗她的右臂和胸部约 8 分钟。她坐在一块防水布上，不停咳嗽，鼻孔和口周有烟灰，鼻毛和眉毛被燎焦，声音嘶哑。烧伤：面部浅表烧伤；躯干前面部分（18%）深浅Ⅱ度烧伤；整条右臂环形部分层烧伤（9%），前臂有几处全层烧伤。她戴着婚戒和手表，一截融化的化纤袖子有几处粘在前臂上。室外 9 摄氏度，地面潮湿。仅一名患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (structure fire, smoke, hot zone - stay where command directs), environment (cold wet night), MOI (closed-space fire with smoke) and one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（建筑火灾、烟雾、热区——按指挥指定位置行动）、环境（湿冷夜间）、受伤机制（充满烟雾的密闭空间火灾）与单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; do not enter the structure
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；不进入建筑物

expected.actionEn: First look: adult female sitting upright, coughing, sooty face, hoarse, obvious burns to face, chest and right arm
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：成年女性端坐、咳嗽、面部有烟灰、声音嘶哑，面部、胸部和右臂有明显烧伤

expected.actionEn: Use the fire crew: continue controlled cooling under your direction, bring the cot to the driveway, and get blankets ready for after cooling stops
expected.actionZh: 调动消防员：在你指导下继续可控降温、把担架床推到车道、并备好停止降温后要用的毯子

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: hoarse, coughing up black sputum, anxious, 'I can't get a deep breath'. EXAMINER: the airway is patent NOW but it is threatened - soot in the oropharynx, hoarse voice, and quiet inspiratory stridor that gets louder over the call. Respirations 28, shallow at times, accessory muscle use, expiratory wheeze bilaterally. SpO2 89% on room air. Tell the candidate that pulse oximetry cannot distinguish carboxyhemoglobin from oxygenated hemoglobin, so a normal reading would not reassure you - treat the smoke inhalation clinically with 15 L by non-rebreather. If respirations become inadequate, assist with a BVM. Radial pulse 122. Unburned skin is pale and clammy. Rapid body survey: no other injuries, she did not fall and did not jump from a window, so spinal precautions are NOT indicated. UNSTABLE: partial thickness burns over 20% BSA, facial and airway burns, and a circumferential limb burn.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：声音嘶哑、咳出黑色痰、焦虑，"我吸不进气"。考官：气道"现在"是通畅的，但已受威胁——口咽部有烟灰、声音嘶哑、可闻及轻微吸气性喘鸣，且在本例过程中逐渐加重。呼吸 28 次/分，时有浅表，有辅助呼吸肌参与，双肺呼气相哮鸣。室内空气 SpO2 89%。请告知考生：脉搏血氧仪无法区分碳氧血红蛋白与氧合血红蛋白，因此读数正常也不能让你放心——对烟雾吸入应按临床判断给予 15 L 非再吸入面罩吸氧。若呼吸变得不足，用 BVM 辅助通气。桡动脉 122。未烧伤区皮肤苍白湿黏。快速查体：无其他损伤，未摔倒也未跳窗，故无脊柱固定指征。不稳定：部分层烧伤面积超过 20% BSA、面部与气道烧伤、且有环形肢体烧伤。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert but anxious
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：清醒但焦虑

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and recognize it is threatened (soot, singed nasal hair, hoarse voice, stridor); keep suction and airway adjuncts immediately at hand
expected.actionZh: 评估气道并识别其已受威胁（烟灰、鼻毛燎焦、声音嘶哑、喘鸣）；把吸引器和气道辅助工具放在触手可及处

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing fully - rate, depth, effort, accessory muscle use and air entry - and be ready to assist ventilation with a BVM
expected.actionZh: 完整评估呼吸——频率、深度、费力程度、辅助肌使用和进气情况——并做好用 BVM 辅助通气的准备

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse present at 122, unburned skin pale and clammy
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：桡动脉可触及、122 次/分，未烧伤皮肤苍白湿黏

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey - expose and examine to find every burn and rule out other injuries
expected.actionZh: 快速查体——暴露检查，找出所有烧伤并排除其他损伤

expected.actionEn: Stop the burning process: remove smouldering clothing and all rings, the watch and jewellery BEFORE swelling; leave adherent melted fabric in place
expected.actionZh: 终止烧伤过程：在肿胀出现"之前"取下所有戒指、手表和首饰，并移除仍在阴燃的衣物；已粘连的融化织物保留原位

expected.actionEn: Note skin: unburned skin pale and clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：未烧伤区苍白湿黏

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather - indicated for smoke inhalation and possible carbon monoxide; a nasal cannula is wrong here
expected.actionZh: 15 L 非再吸入面罩高流量吸氧——烟雾吸入及可能的一氧化碳中毒有此指征；此处用鼻导管是错误的

expected.actionEn: Position sitting upright to protect the airway and ease the work of breathing
expected.actionZh: 取坐位以保护气道并减轻呼吸做功

expected.actionEn: Calculate BSA with the Rule of Nines in the primary survey: anterior trunk 18% plus whole right arm 9% = 27% partial thickness, plus facial burns
expected.actionZh: 在初级评估阶段用九分法计算体表面积：躯干前面 18% ＋ 整条右臂 9% ＝ 27% 部分层烧伤，另有面部烧伤

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Partial thickness burns greater than 20% BSA, facial/airway burns with or without inhalation injury, and a burn that fully encircles a limb are each on their own enough to make this patient unstable - she has all three. RTC, ready to load within 15 minutes, and the airway may close, so early notification matters more than a perfect secondary survey. Surrey Memorial is 8 minutes away; do not wait for the second unit.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。部分层烧伤面积 >20% BSA、面部/气道烧伤（无论是否合并吸入性损伤）、以及完全环绕肢体的烧伤，任何一条单独成立即可判定为不稳定——本例三条全中。RTC，15 分钟内打包完毕；由于气道可能关闭，尽早预报比做完美的二级评估更重要。素里纪念医院 8 分钟车程；不要等第二辆车。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and state the criteria met (>20% partial thickness, facial/airway burn, circumferential limb burn)
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并说明符合的标准（部分层 >20%、面部/气道烧伤、环形肢体烧伤）

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes; complete the remaining cooling time en route rather than sitting on scene
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内打包完毕可装载；剩余降温时间在途中完成，不要滞留现场

expected.actionEn: Early notification for a threatened airway and consider an ALS intercept for airway support
expected.actionZh: 因气道受威胁尽早预报，并考虑与 ALS 会合以获得气道支持

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: the smoke alarm woke her at about 0255; the suite was full of thick smoke and she crawled to the door, and the doorway flashed over as she went through it. She was in the smoke for three or four minutes. There was no explosion, she did not lose consciousness, and she did not jump from anywhere. She smokes half a pack a day. Pain 8/10 in the arm and chest. PMHx: asthma, uses a blue puffer two or three times a week. Meds: salbutamol inhaler, oral contraceptive. Allergies: penicillin (rash). LOI: dinner about 1900, nothing since.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：约 02:55 被烟雾报警器惊醒；套房内浓烟弥漫，她爬向门口，穿过门口时门框处发生轰燃。她在烟雾中待了三到四分钟。没有爆炸，没有昏迷，也没有从任何地方跳下。她每天吸半包烟。手臂和胸部疼痛 8/10。既往史：哮喘，每周用两三次蓝色吸入器。用药：沙丁胺醇吸入剂、口服避孕药。过敏：青霉素（皮疹）。最后进食：约 19:00 晚餐，之后未再进食。

expected.actionEn: Confirm the chief complaint
expected.actionZh: 确认主诉

expected.actionEn: HxC/C: closed space or open air, how long in the smoke, flash or explosion, time of the burn, any LOC, any fall or jump, what she was wearing
expected.actionZh: 现病史：密闭空间还是开阔环境、在烟雾中多久、有无轰燃或爆炸、烧伤时间、有无昏迷、有无坠落或跳下、当时穿着什么

expected.actionEn: Pain score
expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx: asthma and smoking history
expected.actionZh: 既往史：哮喘与吸烟史

expected.actionEn: Medications: salbutamol inhaler, oral contraceptive
expected.actionZh: 用药史：沙丁胺醇吸入剂、口服避孕药

expected.actionEn: Allergies: penicillin
expected.actionZh: 过敏史：青霉素

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后进食时间

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (on scene at 0326, on 15 L NRB): GCS 15 (E4V5M6) but anxious; BP 118/74; pulse 122 regular; respirations 28 shallow with accessory muscle use; unburned skin pale and clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 89% on room air rising to 94% on 15 L - state out loud that this reading is unreliable with possible carbon monoxide; temperature 36.1 C and falling because of the cooling; BGL not indicated (GCS 15, no diabetic history).
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（03:26 现场，已用 15 L 非再吸入面罩）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）但焦虑；血压 118/74；脉搏 122 规则；呼吸 28 浅快、有辅助肌参与；未烧伤皮肤苍白湿黏；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 89%，吸氧后升至 94%——须口头说明存在一氧化碳时该读数不可靠；体温 36.1 摄氏度并因降温而继续下降；血糖无指征（GCS 15、无糖尿病史）。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及三个分项

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure on the unburned left arm
expected.actionZh: 在未烧伤的左臂测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度和节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations - rate, depth, effort and air entry
expected.actionZh: 呼吸——频率、深度、费力程度与进气情况

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed on an unburned area
expected.actionZh: 在未烧伤区域评估皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with the oxygen device recorded, and verbalize that the reading is unreliable with carbon monoxide exposure
expected.actionZh: 记录 SpO2 及给氧方式，并口述在一氧化碳暴露情况下该读数不可靠

phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Burn management: cooling counts from the moment the fire crew started, so 8 minutes are already done - finish 15 to 20 minutes total and then STOP, dry her, and cover the burns with sterile, non-adherent dry dressings. No ice, no cold water immersion, no creams or gels, and do not break blisters. Bronchospasm with a known asthma history: salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer (or 4 x 100 mcg MDI with a spacer) with the six rights and reassessment. Analgesia: Entonox is absolutely CONTRAINDICATED here - inhalation injury is on the contraindication list - and methoxyflurane is cautioned with respiratory compromise, so both are withheld and the rationale documented; effective cooling is itself an analgesic strategy. EMR SCOPE NOTE: no IV, no fluid bolus, no CPAP, no ipratropium, no dexamethasone and no ondansetron at EMR level. CPAP is a particularly dangerous temptation with an airway burn.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。烧伤处理：降温时间从消防员开始冲水时起算，已完成 8 分钟——总共做满 15 至 20 分钟后必须停止，把患者擦干，用无菌不粘干敷料覆盖烧伤面。不用冰、不浸冷水、不涂药膏或凝胶，不要弄破水疱。支气管痉挛合并已知哮喘史：沙丁胺醇 5 mg 雾化（或 MDI 4 喷 ×100 mcg 加储雾罐），执行六项核对并复评。镇痛：本例 Entonox 属绝对禁忌——吸入性损伤就在禁忌清单上；甲氧氟烷在呼吸功能受损时属慎用，故两者都不给并记录理由；有效降温本身就是一种镇痛手段。EMR 范围提示：EMR 层级没有静脉通路、没有补液、没有 CPAP、没有异丙托溴铵、没有地塞米松、没有昂丹司琼。气道烧伤时 CPAP 尤其是一个危险的诱惑。

criticalPitfallsEn: Treating the burns before the airway - a hoarse voice with soot and stridor is an airway emergency; failing to recognize and act on it is an airway auto-fail at 100%
Giving Entonox to a patient with an inhalation injury - it is an absolute contraindication, so this is a protocol violation up to 100%
Choosing a nasal cannula or low-flow oxygen because the SpO2 'looks fine' - pulse oximetry cannot see carboxyhemoglobin; smoke inhalation gets a non-rebreather
Cooling for the whole transport, or using ice or cold water immersion - the total is 15 to 20 minutes including what the fire crew did, and over-cooling causes hypothermia
Leaving the ring and watch on the burned arm until it swells - a circulation loss that was entirely preventable
Calling this non-RTC because 'her vitals are stable' - over 20% partial thickness, facial burns and a circumferential limb burn are each unstable criteria on their own
Applying CPAP or waiting for an IV at EMR level - both are out of scope, and CPAP with a burned upper airway can be actively harmful
criticalPitfallsZh: 先处理烧伤、后处理气道——声音嘶哑合并烟灰和喘鸣就是气道急症；未能识别并采取行动属于气道类直接扣 100% 的重大失误。
给有吸入性损伤的患者使用 Entonox——这是绝对禁忌，属于协议违规，最高扣 100%。
因为 SpO2"看起来还行"就选鼻导管或低流量吸氧——脉搏血氧仪看不见碳氧血红蛋白，烟雾吸入必须用非再吸入面罩。
整个转运过程一直冲水降温，或使用冰块、冷水浸泡——含消防员已做部分在内总共只做 15 至 20 分钟，过度降温会造成低体温。
在手臂肿胀前不取下戒指和手表——这是完全可以避免的远端循环丧失。
因为"生命体征平稳"而判为非 RTC——部分层烧伤 >20%、面部烧伤、环形肢体烧伤，每一条单独都构成不稳定标准。
在 EMR 层级上 CPAP 或原地等待建立静脉通路——两者都超出授权范围，且上气道烧伤时使用 CPAP 可能造成实际伤害。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Everything that keeps this patient alive to the hospital door is EMR scope: a protected and constantly rechecked airway, suction, an OPA or NPA if she loses her gag, BVM assistance if ventilation fails, 15 L by non-rebreather, salbutamol for the bronchospasm, controlled cooling for a total of 15-20 minutes, dry sterile non-adherent dressings, jewellery off early, aggressive rewarming afterwards, and a 15-minute package with early notification. The out-of-scope temptations are CPAP for the stridor and wheeze, an IV with fluids, ipratropium added to the salbutamol, dexamethasone and ondansetron - all PCP-only, none of them an acceptable EMR answer. Entonox is in the EMR formulary but is contraindicated by the inhalation injury.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 把这位患者活着送到医院门口所需的一切都在 EMR 范围内：全程保护并反复复查气道、吸引、必要时置入 OPA 或 NPA、通气不足时用 BVM 辅助、15 L 非再吸入面罩、针对支气管痉挛的沙丁胺醇、总计 15-20 分钟的可控降温、无菌不粘干敷料、早期取下首饰、随后积极复温，以及 15 分钟打包完毕并尽早预报。此处的超范围诱惑是：为喘鸣和哮鸣上 CPAP、建立静脉通路补液、在沙丁胺醇中加异丙托溴铵、使用地塞米松和昂丹司琼——这些全部是 PCP 专属，没有一项是 EMR 的正确答案。Entonox 虽在 EMR 药物目录内，但因吸入性损伤而属禁忌。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route, a 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus to a maximum of 2 litres if she becomes hypotensive, ipratropium 500 mcg added to the salbutamol for the bronchospasm, IV acetaminophen 1 g over 15 minutes for analgesia, and ondansetron for the nausea. PCP also completes the Functional Enquiry. CPAP is still not the answer for an upper-airway burn with stridor; the plan remains oxygen, readiness to ventilate, and speed to a facility that can secure the airway.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路、若出现低血压则给生理盐水 20 mL/kg（上限 2 升）、在沙丁胺醇基础上加用异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 处理支气管痉挛、静脉对乙酰氨基酚 1 g 于 15 分钟内输注镇痛，以及昂丹司琼止吐。PCP 还须完成功能问诊。即便如此，上气道烧伤伴喘鸣仍然不是 CPAP 的适应证；处理原则依旧是给氧、随时准备辅助通气，并尽快送到能建立确定性气道的机构。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 31-year-old female removed by fire from a basement suite fire at about 0255, roughly three to four minutes in heavy smoke in a closed space with a flashover at the doorway as she crawled out. No LOC, no fall, no jump. She has soot around the nose and mouth, singed nasal hairs and eyebrows, a hoarse voice and inspiratory stridor that has become louder during transport, so I am treating her as a threatened airway. Burns are partial thickness across the anterior trunk and circumferentially around the entire right arm, 27 percent by Rule of Nines, plus superficial facial burns. Cooling was started by fire at 0316 and stopped at 0332 for a total of about 16 minutes, then she was dried and covered with dry sterile non-adherent dressings and blankets. First vitals GCS 15, BP 118/74, pulse 122, respirations 28, SpO2 89 percent on room air and 94 on 15 litres, temperature 36.1; latest BP 112/70, pulse 128, respirations 30, SpO2 92 on 15 litres, temperature 35.6. She has asthma, uses salbutamol, is allergic to penicillin, on an oral contraceptive, last ate at 1900. I gave salbutamol 5 milligrams by nebulizer at 0330 for wheeze. Entonox was withheld because of the inhalation injury. Rings and watch were removed on scene. I am an EMR, so no IV and no CPAP.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 31 岁女性，约 02:55 由消防员从地下室套房火灾现场救出，在密闭空间浓烟中约三到四分钟，爬出时门口发生轰燃。无昏迷、无坠落、无跳窗。她鼻孔口周有烟灰、鼻毛与眉毛燎焦、声音嘶哑，转运途中吸气性喘鸣加重，因此我按气道受威胁处理。烧伤为躯干前面及整条右臂环形部分层烧伤，按九分法为 27%，另有面部浅表烧伤。降温由消防于 03:16 开始、03:32 停止，总计约 16 分钟，随后擦干并覆盖无菌不粘干敷料和毯子。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 118/74、脉搏 122、呼吸 28、SpO2 室内空气 89%、15 升下 94%、体温 36.1；末组血压 112/70、脉搏 128、呼吸 30、SpO2 15 升下 92%、体温 35.6。既往哮喘、使用沙丁胺醇、青霉素过敏、口服避孕药，19:00 最后进食。03:30 因哮鸣给予沙丁胺醇 5 mg 雾化。因吸入性损伤未给 Entonox。戒指和手表已在现场取下。我是 EMR，未建立静脉通路、未使用 CPAP。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Freezing rain, 0 degrees C, first light. Three vehicles: a pickup against the median barrier with heavy front-end damage and fuel dripping from it, a sedan facing backwards in the slow lane with the driver's door caved in and the windshield starred, and a third car with no damage whose driver has stopped to help. Police have not yet closed the fast lane and vehicles are still passing at highway speed. There are FOUR patients. If the candidate starts treating the first patient they meet without counting patients and requesting resources, that is a scene-management failure. Once the candidate triages, provide: P1 - 19-year-old male walking around, small forehead laceration, repeating 'is my girlfriend OK'; P2 - 45-year-old female sedan driver, awake, seat-belt bruising across her chest, chest pain, respirations 26, weak fast radial pulse; P3 - 62-year-old male pickup driver, unrestrained, slumped over the wheel, UNRESPONSIVE with snoring respirations and blood in his mouth; P4 - 7-year-old girl in a booster seat in the sedan, crying loudly, no visible injury.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：冻雨，0 摄氏度，天刚亮。三辆车：一辆皮卡撞在中央护栏上、车头严重变形并有燃油滴漏；一辆轿车在慢车道上掉头朝后，驾驶侧车门凹陷、挡风玻璃有星状裂纹；第三辆车没有损坏，司机停车帮忙。警方尚未封闭快车道，车辆仍以高速通过。现场共有四名伤员。若考生不清点人数、不请求资源就直接开始治疗遇到的第一个人，即为现场管理失败。考生开始分诊后依次给出：P1——19 岁男性，能自行走动，前额小裂伤，反复问"我女朋友怎么样了"；P2——45 岁女性轿车司机，清醒，胸前有安全带压痕，主诉胸痛，呼吸 26，桡动脉细快；P3——62 岁男性皮卡司机，未系安全带，趴在方向盘上，无反应，呼吸有鼾声，口中有血；P4——7 岁女孩坐在轿车的增高座椅上，大声哭闹，无可见外伤。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (live traffic, black ice, leaking fuel, glass), environment (freezing rain), MOI (high-speed head-on on ice) and the number of patients - FOUR
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（通行车流、暗冰、漏油、玻璃）、环境（冻雨）、受伤机制（冰面高速正面相撞）以及伤员人数——四人

expected.actionEn: Do not enter the roadway until police block the lane or fire parks a blocking apparatus; work from the protected side
expected.actionZh: 在警方封闭车道或消防车横停防护之前不进入行车道；始终在受保护的一侧作业

expected.actionEn: Global visual sweep before touching anyone: who is walking, who is talking, who is silent
expected.actionZh: 在接触任何人之前先做整体目视扫描：谁能走动、谁在说话、谁一声不出

expected.actionEn: Triage all four: P3 unresponsive with a compromised airway is FIRST, P2 with chest trauma and shock signs is second, P4 the crying child is third, P1 the walking wounded is last
expected.actionZh: 对四人全部分诊：P3 无反应且气道受累——第一优先；P2 胸部创伤合并休克征象——第二；P4 哭闹的儿童——第三；P1 能走动的轻伤者——最后

expected.actionEn: Report the patient count and severity to dispatch and confirm the additional ambulances; assign the fire first responders to monitor P2 and stay with P4 and P1 until relieved
expected.actionZh: 向调度报告伤员人数与伤情等级并确认增援车辆；指派消防急救员监护 P2 并陪同 P4 和 P1，直至有人接替

phases.infoEn: The candidate commits to P3, the unresponsive pickup driver. ACTOR: unresponsive, snoring, blood and a broken denture in the mouth, slumped forward against the wheel. EXAMINER: this is an unconscious trauma patient in a high-speed crash - SPINAL PRECAUTIONS ARE INDICATED and manual C-spine control must be taken from behind before anything else. Snoring means the tongue is obstructing: a jaw thrust without head tilt opens it, suction clears the blood, and an OPA is tolerated (no gag). Respirations are 8 and shallow - inadequate, so assist with a BVM at 10-12 per minute with 15 L and a reservoir. Carotid pulse 124, weak; radial pulse present but thready. Skin pale, cool, clammy. Rapid body survey: 8 cm scalp laceration bleeding steadily (control with direct pressure and a dressing), boggy area over the right temple, deformed right forearm, no other external hemorrhage. Right pupil 5 mm and sluggish, left 3 mm and reactive. UNSTABLE: unconscious, airway compromise, inadequate respirations, shock signs, new neurological deficit.
phases.infoZh: 考生选定 P3——无反应的皮卡司机。患者演员：无反应、呼吸带鼾声、口中有血和一副断裂的假牙，身体前倾压在方向盘上。考官：这是高速碰撞中的昏迷创伤患者——有脊柱固定指征，必须先从后方徒手固定颈椎再做其他任何操作。鼾声说明舌根后坠阻塞气道：用不后仰头部的托颌法可打开气道，吸引清除血液，患者能耐受口咽通气道（无呕吐反射）。呼吸 8 次/分且浅——属于不足，须用 BVM 以 10-12 次/分、15 L 加储氧袋辅助通气。颈动脉 124、细弱；桡动脉可触及但细。皮肤苍白湿冷。快速查体：头皮 8 厘米裂伤持续出血（直接加压加敷料控制）、右颞部有波动感肿胀、右前臂畸形、无其他外出血。右瞳孔 5 毫米、反应迟钝，左瞳孔 3 毫米、反应正常。不稳定：昏迷、气道受累、呼吸不足、休克征象、新发神经功能缺损。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Unresponsive
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Unresponsive（无反应）

expected.actionEn: Take manual C-spine control from behind BEFORE moving the head or opening the airway - unconscious trauma patient in a high-speed MVC
expected.actionZh: 在移动头部或开放气道之前，先从后方徒手固定颈椎——高速车祸中的昏迷创伤患者

expected.actionEn: Open and clear the airway: jaw thrust without head tilt, suction the blood, remove the broken denture, insert an OPA
expected.actionZh: 开放并清理气道：不后仰头部的托颌法、吸引口内血液、取出断裂假牙、置入口咽通气道

expected.actionEn: Recognize inadequate respirations at 8 shallow and assist ventilation immediately with a BVM at 10-12/min with 15 L and reservoir
expected.actionZh: 识别呼吸 8 次/分且浅属于不足，立即用 BVM 以 10-12 次/分、15 L 加储氧袋辅助通气

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: carotid and radial pulses, recognize shock
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：颈动脉与桡动脉搏动，识别休克

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey head to toe and control the scalp hemorrhage with direct pressure and a dressing
expected.actionZh: 从头到脚快速查体，并用直接加压加敷料控制头皮出血

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale, cool, clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、湿冷

expected.actionEn: Oxygen 15 L through the BVM reservoir - a non-rebreather is not enough for a patient who is not breathing adequately
expected.actionZh: 经 BVM 储氧袋给 15 L 氧——对通气不足的患者，非再吸入面罩不够用

expected.actionEn: Rapid extrication with fire assistance onto a scoop or long board, kept in line, then supine with the airway managed and blankets on
expected.actionZh: 在消防协助下快速脱困、整体轴向移到铲式或长脊板上，随后仰卧、持续管理气道并盖毯保暖

phases.infoEn: Decision point. P3 is unconscious with an unmanaged airway, inadequate breathing, shock and a new neurological deficit - RTC, ready to load within 15 minutes, and he goes in YOUR ambulance now. P2 stays with the fire first responders on oxygen and goes with the second unit in 12 minutes; P4 and P1 go with the third unit. State those assignments out loud and pass them to the incoming crews and to dispatch; do not wait on scene to see the other patients again.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。P3 昏迷、气道未受控、呼吸不足、有休克和新发神经功能缺损——判为 RTC，15 分钟内打包完毕，并立即用你这辆车转运。P2 留给消防急救员吸氧监护，12 分钟后随第二辆车走；P4 和 P1 随第三辆车走。这些分配必须口头说明并交接给后续到场的车组和调度；不要留在现场再去看其他伤员。

expected.actionEn: Categorize P3 as RTC and transport him first
expected.actionZh: 将 P3 判定为 RTC 并优先转运

expected.actionEn: Packaged and ready to be lifted onto the cot within 15 minutes despite the extrication
expected.actionZh: 尽管需要脱困，仍在 15 分钟内打包完毕、可抬上担架床

expected.actionEn: Hand over scene command and the triage assignments to the incoming crews and dispatch before you leave
expected.actionZh: 离场前把现场指挥权和分诊结果移交给后续车组与调度

phases.infoEn: The patient is unresponsive, so the history is collateral. EXAMINER: the 19-year-old witness says the pickup crossed the centre line on the ice and hit the sedan head-on at highway speed, roughly 80 km/h, about four minutes before you arrived; the pickup driver was not wearing a seat belt and the windshield is starred where his head hit. He has not moved or spoken since. RCMP hand you a medical alert bracelet reading 'Atrial fibrillation - warfarin' and a pill bottle from the door pocket labelled warfarin 5 mg and metoprolol 50 mg. His wallet gives his date of birth - he is 62. No allergy information is available and nobody knows when he last ate; the coffee cup in the holder is still warm.
phases.infoZh: 患者无反应，因此病史来自旁证。考官：19 岁的目击者说皮卡在冰面上越过中线，以约 80 km/h 的高速正面撞上轿车，大约在你到场前 4 分钟；皮卡司机没系安全带，挡风玻璃上有他头部撞击留下的星状裂纹。此后他一直没有动过、没有说过话。RCMP 递给你一只医疗警示手环，上面写着"心房颤动——华法林"，以及从车门储物格里找到的药瓶，标签为华法林 5 mg 和美托洛尔 50 mg。钱包里的出生日期显示他 62 岁。没有过敏信息，也没人知道他最后一次进食时间；杯架里的咖啡还是温的。

expected.actionEn: State the chief complaint as an unresponsive trauma patient with head injury after a high-speed head-on collision
expected.actionZh: 将主诉表述为：高速正面碰撞后无反应的创伤患者，合并头部损伤

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from witnesses and police: speed, restraint use, windshield starring, compartment intrusion, whether he has been moved, and how long he has been unresponsive
expected.actionZh: 向目击者和警方采集现病史：车速、是否系安全带、挡风玻璃星状裂纹、驾驶舱侵入、是否被移动过、无反应已持续多久

expected.actionEn: PMHx from the medical alert bracelet: atrial fibrillation - and recognize that anticoagulation makes this head injury far more dangerous
expected.actionZh: 从医疗警示手环获取既往史：心房颤动——并意识到抗凝治疗会使本例颅脑损伤危险得多

expected.actionEn: Medications from the pill bottle: warfarin 5 mg and metoprolol 50 mg (a beta blocker can blunt the tachycardic response to blood loss); take the bottle to hospital
expected.actionZh: 从药瓶获取用药史：华法林 5 mg、美托洛尔 50 mg（β 受体阻滞剂会钝化失血时的心率代偿）；把药瓶一并带到医院

expected.actionEn: Allergies: unobtainable - document as unknown rather than skipping the question
expected.actionZh: 过敏史：无法获取——记录为"未知"，而不是跳过这一项

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake: unknown, warm coffee in the vehicle - document what you observed
expected.actionZh: 最后进食：不详，车内咖啡尚温——把观察到的情况记录下来

expected.actionEn: Pain scale cannot be obtained; document why and use objective findings instead
expected.actionZh: 疼痛评分无法获取；记录原因并改用客观体征替代

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (0726, after extrication, BVM in progress): GCS 7 (E1 V2 M4); BP 88/54; pulse 124 weak regular; respirations 8 shallow before assistance, now assisted at 12; skin pale cool clammy; pupils - right 5 mm sluggish, left 3 mm reactive; SpO2 84% on room air rising to 96% with BVM and 15 L; BGL 6.4 mmol/L (INDICATED - altered LOC); temperature 35.9 C (freezing rain exposure).
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（07:26，脱困后，正在 BVM 辅助通气）：GCS 7（E1 V2 M4）；血压 88/54；脉搏 124 细弱规则；辅助前呼吸 8 次/分且浅，现辅助至 12 次/分；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔——右 5 毫米反应迟钝、左 3 毫米反应正常；SpO2 室内空气 84%，BVM 加 15 L 后升至 96%；血糖 6.4 mmol/L（有指征——意识改变）；体温 35.9 摄氏度（冻雨暴露）。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components scored separately - this is the number the trauma team will compare against
expected.actionZh: GCS 三个分项分别评分并报出——这是创伤团队用来对比的关键数字

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 听诊法测量血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations - rate, depth and adequacy, documented before and after assistance
expected.actionZh: 呼吸——频率、深度与是否足够，分别记录辅助前与辅助后

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手评估皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils - the unequal sluggish right pupil is a critical finding to report
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——右侧瞳孔不等大且反应迟钝，是必须上报的关键发现

expected.actionEn: SpO2 recorded with the device and flow rate
expected.actionZh: 记录 SpO2 及所用给氧装置与流量

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - indicated in any patient with an altered level of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 血糖——任何意识水平改变的患者都有测量指征

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated after prolonged exposure to freezing rain
expected.actionZh: 体温——在冻雨中长时间暴露后有测量指征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY. The patient is unresponsive, so the Functional Enquiry cannot be taken from him - the candidate should still work through the systems using the witness, the medical alert bracelet, the medication bottle and objective findings, and document each system as collateral or unobtainable. EXAMINER (collateral from the coworker who follows in a truck): general - he has been well and works full time; CNS - no known seizures or strokes, on warfarin for an irregular heart; respiratory - smoker, gets short of breath on stairs; cardiovascular - atrial fibrillation on metoprolol; GI/GU - nothing known; integumentary - nothing known; musculoskeletal - old back injury; endocrine - not diabetic; EENT - wears glasses, which were found on the dash.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP。患者无反应，功能问诊无法向本人采集——考生仍应借助目击者、医疗警示手环、药瓶和客观体征逐系统过一遍，并把每个系统记录为旁证所得或无法获取。考官（开车跟来的同事提供的旁证）：整体——他一直身体不错、全职工作；中枢神经——无已知癫痫或卒中，因心律不齐服华法林；呼吸——吸烟，爬楼梯会气短；心血管——心房颤动，服美托洛尔；消化/泌尿——不清楚；皮肤——不清楚；肌肉骨骼——有陈旧腰伤；内分泌——非糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——戴眼镜，眼镜在仪表台上找到。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (collateral)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康（旁证）

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (collateral)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经系统（旁证）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (collateral)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸系统（旁证）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (collateral: atrial fibrillation on warfarin)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管系统（旁证：心房颤动、服华法林）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (document as unobtainable)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿系统（记录为无法获取）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (objective findings only)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤系统（仅记录客观所见）

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal (collateral)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼系统（旁证）

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine (not diabetic - supports the normal BGL)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌系统（非糖尿病，与血糖正常相符）

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (collateral)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（旁证）

phases.infoEn: EN-ROUTE head-to-toe with the airway continuously managed: head - 8 cm scalp laceration to the forehead now dressed and no longer bleeding through, boggy swelling over the right temple, blood and a broken denture already cleared from the mouth, no CSF from the ears or nose; neck - trachea midline, no JVD, collar applied and rechecked; chest - no seat belt marks because he was unrestrained, bruising over the sternum from the steering wheel, air entry equal but decreased at both bases; abdomen - soft, bruising across the upper abdomen from the wheel; back - checked during the log roll onto the scoop, no step or deformity; upper extremities - deformed and swollen right forearm with a present radial pulse; lower extremities - both knees struck the dash, right knee swollen, pedal pulses present.
phases.infoZh: 途中在持续管理气道的同时完成从头到脚检查：头部——前额 8 厘米头皮裂伤已包扎、未再渗透，右颞部有波动样肿胀，口内血液和断裂假牙已清除，耳鼻无脑脊液漏；颈部——气管居中、无颈静脉怒张，颈托已戴好并复查；胸部——因未系安全带故无安全带压痕，胸骨区有方向盘造成的瘀斑，双肺进气对称但两下肺呼吸音减弱；腹部——柔软，上腹有方向盘造成的瘀斑；背部——在轴向翻身移上铲式担架时已检查，无台阶感或畸形；上肢——右前臂畸形肿胀，桡动脉搏动可触及；下肢——双膝撞击仪表台，右膝肿胀，足背动脉搏动可触及。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck: scalp wound, temporal swelling, ears and nose for CSF, trachea and collar check
expected.actionZh: 头颈：头皮伤口、颞部肿胀、耳鼻有无脑脊液、气管位置与颈托检查

expected.actionEn: Chest with auscultation at six sites
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并在 6 个部位听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen - steering wheel bruising in an unrestrained driver
expected.actionZh: 腹部——未系安全带司机身上的方向盘瘀斑

expected.actionEn: Back inspected and palpated during the log roll
expected.actionZh: 轴向翻身时视诊并触诊背部

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities including distal pulse in the deformed forearm
expected.actionZh: 上肢查体，包括畸形前臂的远端脉搏

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities including pedal pulses
expected.actionZh: 下肢查体，包括足背动脉搏动

phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Airway is the whole call: continuous suction, OPA, jaw thrust, BVM at 10-12 per minute with 15 L - do not hyperventilate a head-injured patient. Spinal management: manual control from first contact, correctly sized collar, rapid extrication onto a scoop or board with fire assistance, head blocks and straps, and the manual control is only released once he is fully secured. Wound care: dress the scalp laceration - it can bleed significantly, especially on warfarin. Fracture management: splint the right forearm with a distal pulse check before and after, but do it during packaging or en route so it never delays an RTC transport. Warmth: he was lying in freezing rain, so remove wet clothing, dry him and use blankets. Analgesia: Entonox and methoxyflurane are both CONTRAINDICATED with a decreased level of consciousness and a head injury; nothing by mouth in an unresponsive patient. EMR SCOPE NOTE: no IV, no fluids, no TXA at EMR level - your airway skills and your speed are the treatment.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。本例的核心是气道：持续吸引、口咽通气道、托颌法、BVM 以 10-12 次/分加 15 L 给氧——颅脑损伤患者切勿过度通气。脊柱管理：从第一次接触起徒手固定、选择合适尺寸的颈托、在消防协助下快速脱困移上铲式担架或脊板、加头部固定块和固定带，只有在完全固定后才能松开徒手固定。伤口处理：包扎头皮裂伤——头皮出血量可以很大，服华法林者尤甚。骨折处理：夹板固定右前臂，前后各查一次远端脉搏，但必须在打包过程中或途中完成，绝不能因此延误 RTC 转运。保暖：他一直躺在冻雨中，须脱去湿衣、擦干并盖毯。镇痛：意识水平下降合并颅脑损伤时，Entonox 和甲氧氟烷均属禁忌；无反应患者禁止口服任何药物。EMR 范围提示：EMR 层级没有静脉通路、没有补液、没有 TXA——你的气道技能和转运速度就是治疗。

expected.actionEn: Airway management skill: suction, OPA, jaw thrust maintained, airway rechecked after every move
expected.actionZh: 气道管理技能：吸引、口咽通气道、持续托颌，每次移动后复查气道

expected.actionEn: Breathing management skill: BVM at 10-12 per minute with 15 L and reservoir, watching chest rise, avoiding hyperventilation and gastric insufflation
expected.actionZh: 呼吸管理技能：BVM 以 10-12 次/分、15 L 加储氧袋通气，观察胸廓起伏，避免过度通气和胃胀气

expected.actionEn: Spinal management skill: manual control, collar, scoop or board, head blocks and straps, manual control released only when fully secured
expected.actionZh: 脊柱管理技能：徒手固定、颈托、铲式担架或脊板、头部固定块与固定带，完全固定后才松手

expected.actionEn: Wound management skill: dressing and pressure on the scalp laceration, monitored for re-bleeding in an anticoagulated patient
expected.actionZh: 伤口处理技能：头皮裂伤敷料加压，并在抗凝患者中持续观察有无再出血

expected.actionEn: Fracture management skill: splint the right forearm with distal pulse checks before and after, without delaying transport
expected.actionZh: 骨折处理技能：夹板固定右前臂，前后各查远端脉搏，且不延误转运

expected.actionEn: Head injury management: ventilate at a normal rate, keep SpO2 up, avoid hypotension, and transport without delay
expected.actionZh: 颅脑损伤处理：以正常频率通气、维持 SpO2、避免低血压、立即转运

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that Entonox and methoxyflurane are contraindicated with a decreased LOC and head injury, and that nothing goes by mouth
expected.actionZh: 口述在意识水平下降合并颅脑损伤时 Entonox 与甲氧氟烷均属禁忌，且不得给予任何口服药物

phases.infoEn: Reassess the ABCs after the extrication, after loading and every few minutes - the airway of an unconscious patient never stays fixed. Recheck the pupils and the GCS for deterioration, and recheck the scalp dressing. Set 2 (0734, en route, ventilated): GCS 8 (E2 V2 M4); BP 92/58; pulse 118 weak regular; respirations assisted at 12; skin pale cool; pupils right 5 mm sluggish, left 3 mm reactive (unchanged); SpO2 97% with BVM and 15 L; BGL not repeated; temperature 36.0 C after blankets and heat.
phases.infoZh: 在脱困后、装车后以及每隔数分钟复评 ABC——昏迷患者的气道从来不会"一直保持通畅"。复查瞳孔和 GCS 有无恶化，并复查头皮敷料。第 2 组（07:34，途中，辅助通气中）：GCS 8（E2 V2 M4）；血压 92/58；脉搏 118 细弱规则；辅助呼吸 12 次/分；皮肤苍白发凉；瞳孔右 5 毫米反应迟钝、左 3 毫米反应正常（无变化）；SpO2 BVM 加 15 L 下 97%；血糖不复测；盖毯并升温后体温 36.0 摄氏度。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and the airway adjunct after the extrication and after every move
expected.actionZh: 脱困后及每次移动后复评 ABC 与气道辅助工具的位置

expected.actionEn: Second complete set of vitals within 7-8 minutes, with GCS and pupils compared against the first set
expected.actionZh: 7-8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并将 GCS 和瞳孔与第一组对比

expected.actionEn: Recheck the scalp dressing and the splinted forearm's distal circulation
expected.actionZh: 复查头皮敷料以及夹板固定前臂的远端循环

expected.actionEn: Keep ventilating at a normal rate and keep him warm - do not hyperventilate and do not let him get cold
expected.actionZh: 维持正常频率通气并持续保暖——不要过度通气，也不要让他受凉

phases.infoEn: Notify Abbotsford Regional early: unconscious head injury, GCS 7, unequal pupils, anticoagulated on warfarin, ventilated, ETA. The hand-off must include the mechanism, that he was unrestrained, the GCS trend, the pupil finding, the warfarin, and that there are three more patients coming from the same scene. PCR within 5 minutes and it must document the triage decisions as well as this patient's care.
phases.infoZh: 尽早向阿伯茨福德区域医院预报：昏迷性颅脑损伤、GCS 7、瞳孔不等大、正在服华法林抗凝、已辅助通气、预计到达时间。交接必须包括受伤机制、未系安全带、GCS 变化趋势、瞳孔发现、华法林用药，以及同一现场还有另外三名伤员随后到达。PCR 须在 5 分钟内完成，且必须同时记录分诊决定和本患者的处置。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification: unconscious head injury with unequal pupils on warfarin, plus a heads-up that three more patients are coming
expected.actionZh: 途中预报：昏迷性颅脑损伤、瞳孔不等大、服用华法林，并提前告知还有三名伤员将陆续送达

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off including mechanism, restraint status, GCS trend, pupils, airway interventions and anticoagulation
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，含受伤机制、是否系安全带、GCS 变化、瞳孔、气道处置与抗凝用药

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes documenting both the triage assignments and this patient's care
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，同时记录分诊分配与本患者的处置

criticalPitfallsEn: Starting treatment on the first patient you meet - the walking 19-year-old - without counting patients and calling for resources; as the first crew you own the scene until you are relieved
Walking into a live traffic lane before police or a blocking apparatus protects the scene
Not taking C-spine control on an unconscious patient from a high-speed crash - 100%
Hearing snoring respirations and not opening, suctioning and maintaining the airway - 100%
Recognizing respirations of 8 and shallow but only applying a non-rebreather instead of assisting with a BVM - 100%
Leaving P2, P4 and P1 with no assignment, no monitoring and no report to the incoming crews
Hyperventilating the head-injured patient, or delaying departure to splint the forearm perfectly
criticalPitfallsZh: 不清点伤员、不请求资源，就直接对遇到的第一个人——那位能走动的 19 岁伤者——开始治疗；作为首到车组，在有人接替之前现场由你负责。
在警方封闭车道或有车辆横停防护之前就走进仍在通行的行车道。
对高速碰撞后昏迷的患者不实施颈椎控制——扣 100%。
听到鼾式呼吸却没有开放、吸引并维持气道——扣 100%。
判断出呼吸 8 次/分且浅，却只扣上非再吸入面罩而不用 BVM 辅助通气——扣 100%。
把 P2、P4、P1 丢在现场，既不分配人员、也不监护、也不向后续车组交接。
对颅脑损伤患者过度通气，或为了把前臂夹板做得完美而延误出发。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: In BC an EMR crew is very often the first ambulance on a highway crash, so this scenario tests the part of the job that is pure EMR: count the patients, call for what you need before you are buried in patient care, sort by ABCs, and then deliver excellent basic care to the sickest one. Everything this patient needs is in EMR scope - manual C-spine, suction, OPA, jaw thrust, BVM ventilation, collar and board, hemorrhage control, splinting, warmth and a 15-minute package. The out-of-scope temptations are an IV with fluids and TXA for the head injury; neither is an EMR answer, and neither is a substitute for ventilating him properly.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 在 BC，高速公路事故的第一辆救护车常常就是 EMR 车组，因此本场景考的正是最纯粹的 EMR 工作：清点伤员、在被患者照护"淹没"之前先把需要的资源叫齐、按 ABC 排序，然后把最重的那个患者的基础处置做到极致。这位患者所需的一切都在 EMR 范围内——徒手颈椎固定、吸引、口咽通气道、托颌、BVM 通气、颈托与脊板、止血、夹板、保暖，以及 15 分钟内完成打包。超范围的诱惑是为颅脑损伤建立静脉通路补液和使用 TXA；这两项都不是 EMR 的答案，也都替代不了把通气做对。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route, a 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus to a maximum of 2 litres reassessed every 500 mL if he stays hypotensive (hypotension is devastating in a head injury), TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute if it is indicated within the 3-hour window, and the full Functional Enquiry from collateral sources. The airway management, ventilation rate and spinal care are identical - they are what actually determine this patient's outcome.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路、若持续低血压则给生理盐水 20 mL/kg（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评，低血压对颅脑损伤患者极其致命）、在 3 小时窗内有指征时给 TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟，以及通过旁证完成完整功能问诊。气道管理、通气频率和脊柱处理完全相同——真正决定该患者结局的正是这几项。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 62-year-old male, the unrestrained driver of a pickup that crossed the centre line on ice and hit a sedan head-on at about 80 kilometres an hour at 0711. He has been unresponsive since impact, with a starred windshield where his head struck. On arrival he was snoring with blood and a broken denture in his mouth; I took manual C-spine, suctioned, inserted an oral airway and have been ventilating him with a bag-valve mask at 12 per minute on 15 litres since 0722. His first GCS was 7, E1 V2 M4, with a right pupil at 5 millimetres and sluggish and the left at 3 and reactive; his latest GCS is 8, E2 V2 M4, with the pupils unchanged. First vitals BP 88/54, pulse 124 weak, SpO2 84 percent on room air corrected to 96 with the bag, glucose 6.4, temperature 35.9; latest BP 92/58, pulse 118, SpO2 97, temperature 36.0. He wears a medical alert bracelet for atrial fibrillation and his medication bottle shows warfarin 5 milligrams and metoprolol 50 milligrams, which I have brought with me - he is anticoagulated with a significant head injury. Injuries are an 8 centimetre scalp laceration now dressed, boggy right temporal swelling, steering wheel bruising to the sternum and upper abdomen, and a deformed right forearm splinted with a good radial pulse. He is fully immobilized on a scoop. Allergies and last oral intake are unknown. Three more patients are coming from the same scene: a 45-year-old female with chest trauma, a 7-year-old restrained child, and a walking 19-year-old with a forehead laceration.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 62 岁男性，是那辆在冰面越过中线、07:11 以约 80 公里时速正面撞上轿车的皮卡司机，未系安全带。撞击后一直无反应，挡风玻璃上有他头部撞击的星状裂纹。我到场时他呼吸带鼾声、口内有血和断裂假牙；我实施了徒手颈椎固定、吸引、置入口咽通气道，并自 07:22 起用 BVM 以 12 次/分、15 L 给氧辅助通气。首次 GCS 7（E1 V2 M4），右瞳孔 5 毫米、反应迟钝，左瞳孔 3 毫米、反应正常；最新 GCS 8（E2 V2 M4），瞳孔无变化。首组生命体征血压 88/54、脉搏 124 细弱、SpO2 室内空气 84% 经辅助通气纠正至 96%、血糖 6.4、体温 35.9；末组血压 92/58、脉搏 118、SpO2 97%、体温 36.0。他佩戴心房颤动的医疗警示手环，药瓶显示华法林 5 mg 和美托洛尔 50 mg，药瓶我已一并带来——他在抗凝状态下发生了严重颅脑损伤。损伤包括：已包扎的 8 厘米头皮裂伤、右颞部波动样肿胀、胸骨与上腹的方向盘瘀斑、右前臂畸形已夹板固定且桡动脉搏动良好。他已在铲式担架上完成整体固定。过敏史和最后进食时间不详。同一现场还有三名伤员将陆续送达：一名 45 岁女性胸部创伤、一名 7 岁已系安全座椅的儿童、以及一名能走动、前额裂伤的 19 岁男性。

scenarios.titleEn: Electrical Contact and Fall - Electrician Off a Ladder
scenarios.titleZh: 触电合并坠落——电工从梯子上被电击摔下
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1140 hrs. Code 3 to a commercial renovation on Kingsway in Burnaby. A 38-year-old male electrician contacted an energized 347-volt lighting panel while working from a 3.5-metre ladder and was thrown onto a concrete floor. A coworker says he went stiff and shook for a few seconds, then went limp. Burnaby Fire is on scene, BC Hydro has been notified. Burnaby Hospital is 7 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 11:40，Code 3 前往本拿比 Kingsway 一处商业装修工地。一名 38 岁男性电工在 3.5 米高的梯子上作业时接触到带电的 347 伏照明配电盘，被弹摔到水泥地面上。同事说他先是全身僵直抽动了几秒，随后瘫软不动。本拿比消防已在现场，BC Hydro（电力公司）已接到通知。本拿比医院车程 7 分钟。

phases.infoEn: En-route update: fire reports the patient is clear of the electrical source and is now conscious but confused. The panel is still energized and has been taped off; the apprentice believes he opened the correct breaker but BC Hydro is 25 minutes away and has not confirmed anything.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：消防报告患者已脱离电源，现在清醒但意识模糊。配电盘仍然带电、已用警戒带围起；学徒认为自己已经拉下了正确的断路器，但 BC Hydro 还有 25 分钟才到，尚未确认任何事情。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and state the safety rule out loud: no one approaches until qualified personnel confirm the source is isolated and locked out - 'the apprentice thinks he opened the breaker' is not confirmation
expected.actionZh: 确认出车并口述安全准则：在有资质人员确认电源已隔离并挂牌上锁之前任何人不得靠近——"学徒认为自己拉了闸"不算确认

expected.actionEn: Plan for a dual mechanism: electrical injury with an entry and exit wound and a dysrhythmia risk, plus a 3.5-metre fall onto concrete with spinal and head injury
expected.actionZh: 按双重受伤机制做准备：既有带入口和出口伤的电击伤及心律失常风险，又有从 3.5 米高坠落至水泥地的脊柱和头部损伤

expected.actionEn: Anticipate electrical hazard, construction debris, dust and blood exposure; PPE including eye protection and a hard hat
expected.actionZh: 预判电击危险、施工碎屑、粉尘和血液暴露；个人防护含护目镜与安全帽

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The fire captain meets you at the door. He confirms the main has been opened AND locked and tagged out by a qualified electrician, the panel has been tested dead, and a safe path is marked - only now may the candidate enter. If the candidate walks past the captain and goes straight to the patient without confirming isolation, stop the scenario and record it as a scene-safety failure. The patient is lying supine on the concrete, two metres from the fibreglass ladder, which is on its side. His hard hat is three metres away. He is awake but confused, repeating the same question. There is a smell of burnt hair. One patient. The fire crew of four is available to help.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：消防队长在门口迎接你。他确认总闸已经拉下、并由有资质的电工完成挂牌上锁，配电盘已测电确认无电，且已标出安全通道——此时考生才可以进入。若考生径直越过队长、不确认电源隔离就冲向患者，请中止本场景并记录为现场安全失败。患者仰卧在水泥地上，距离侧倒的玻璃钢梯子约 2 米。他的安全帽掉在 3 米外。他清醒但意识模糊，反复问同一个问题。空气中有毛发烧焦的气味。仅一名患者。现场有四名消防员可协助。

expected.actionEn: Confirm with fire that the source is isolated, locked and tagged out and tested dead BEFORE approaching the patient
expected.actionZh: 在靠近患者之前，先向消防确认电源已隔离、挂牌上锁并测电确认无电

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (energized panel now isolated, ladder, debris, dust), environment (indoor construction site), MOI (347 V contact plus a 3.5 m fall onto concrete) and one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（已隔离的带电配电盘、梯子、碎屑、粉尘）、环境（室内施工现场）、受伤机制（347 伏触电加从 3.5 米坠落至水泥地）与单一患者

expected.actionEn: First look: adult male supine on concrete, awake but confused, hard hat displaced, burnt hair smell
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：成年男性仰卧在水泥地上，清醒但意识模糊，安全帽已脱落，有毛发烧焦气味

expected.actionEn: Use the fire crew: one to hold C-spine, others for the scoop, lighting and equipment
expected.actionZh: 调动消防员：一人负责徒手固定颈椎，其他人负责铲式担架、照明与器材

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake, confused, asks 'what happened' repeatedly, does not remember the fall, complains his whole body aches. EXAMINER: he lost consciousness for about a minute according to the coworker. SPINAL PRECAUTIONS ARE INDICATED - a fall from 3.5 metres onto concrete, an altered level of consciousness and an injury above the clavicles. Airway is patent and he is speaking. Respirations 24 and unlaboured, equal air entry. Radial pulse 112 and IRREGULAR - after an electrical contact this matters, so apply AED pads early to monitor and be ready to defibrillate if he arrests. Skin pale, cool, clammy. Rapid body survey: a 3 cm charred full-thickness wound on the right palm with a painless centre (entry), a 2 cm charred wound on the sole of the left heel found when the boot is cut off (exit), meaning the current crossed the chest; an abrasion and small hematoma over the right occiput; an obviously deformed left wrist with a radial pulse present; no major external bleeding. UNSTABLE: full-thickness burns involving the hand and foot, altered LOC after a significant fall, and an irregular pulse after electrical contact.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒但意识模糊，反复问"发生什么事了"，不记得摔倒的过程，主诉全身酸痛。考官：据同事说他曾昏迷约一分钟。有脊柱固定指征——从 3.5 米高坠落至水泥地、意识水平改变、且锁骨以上有损伤。气道通畅，能说话。呼吸 24 次/分、不费力，双肺进气对称。桡动脉 112 次/分且节律不齐——触电后这一点意义重大，因此应尽早贴上 AED 电极片进行监护，一旦心搏骤停可立即除颤。皮肤苍白湿冷。快速查体：右手掌 3 厘米焦黑全层伤口、中心区无痛觉（入口），剪开左靴后在左足跟底发现 2 厘米焦黑伤口（出口）——说明电流穿过了胸部；右枕部擦伤伴小血肿；左腕明显畸形但桡动脉搏动可触及；无大量外出血。不稳定：累及手和足的全层烧伤、明显坠落后意识改变、以及触电后脉律不齐。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert but confused, with a reported one-minute loss of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：清醒但意识模糊，据报曾昏迷约一分钟

expected.actionEn: Take manual C-spine control immediately - 3.5 m fall onto concrete, altered LOC and an occipital injury
expected.actionZh: 立即徒手固定颈椎——从 3.5 米坠落至水泥地、意识改变、且有枕部损伤

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing - rate, depth, effort and equal air entry
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸——频率、深度、费力程度与双肺进气是否对称

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation and specifically identify the irregular pulse as a post-electrical dysrhythmia risk
expected.actionZh: 评估循环，并明确指出脉律不齐提示触电后心律失常风险

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey looking specifically for entry and exit wounds - cut the boot off to find the exit wound and map the current path across the chest
expected.actionZh: 快速查体并专门寻找电流入口与出口伤——剪开靴子找到出口伤，据此判断电流经过胸部的路径

expected.actionEn: Apply AED pads early for monitoring and immediate defibrillation if he arrests
expected.actionZh: 尽早贴上 AED 电极片进行监护，一旦骤停可立即除颤

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale, cool, clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、湿冷

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L by non-rebreather - altered LOC and trauma
expected.actionZh: 15 L 非再吸入面罩高流量吸氧——意识改变合并创伤

expected.actionEn: Keep him supine and in line, insulated from the cold concrete, with blankets on
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧、轴向对位，与冰凉的水泥地面隔开，并盖毯保暖

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Third-degree burns involving the hand and the foot, an altered level of consciousness after a 3.5-metre fall onto concrete, and an irregular pulse after current crossed the chest each make him unstable - RTC, ready to be lifted within 15 minutes. Burnaby Hospital is 7 minutes away; follow local destination protocol and notify early. Do not stay on scene waiting for BC Hydro.

phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Electrical Contact guideline: consider spinal motion restriction (done), supplemental oxygen, flush and decontaminate the entry and exit wounds with sterile saline, do NOT cool burns longer than 15-20 minutes including the decontamination time, dress the wounds, identify the type of current and the duration of contact, estimate the burn surface area, and initiate conveyance. Because he has been on cold concrete and has had saline decontamination, use the ambulance heater and blankets to prevent hypothermia. Fracture management: splint the left wrist in the position found with distal circulation, motor and sensation checked before and after. Analgesia: Entonox is CONTRAINDICATED with an altered level of consciousness, and methoxyflurane is contraindicated with a decreased LOC or head injury - withhold both and document why; do not give anything by mouth to a confused patient who may need surgery. EMR SCOPE NOTE: no IV and no fluid bolus at the EMR level, and there is no EMR intervention for a dysrhythmia other than AED pads, oxygen and rapid transport.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。触电处理指南：考虑脊柱运动限制（已完成）、按需给氧、用无菌生理盐水冲洗并清洁入口与出口伤、烧伤降温连同清洗时间总共不得超过 15-20 分钟、包扎伤口、明确电流类型和接触时长、估算烧伤体表面积、并尽快启动转运。由于患者一直躺在冰凉水泥地上且做过盐水冲洗，须使用车内暖气和毯子预防低体温。骨折处理：按发现时的姿势夹板固定左腕，固定前后分别检查远端循环、运动和感觉。镇痛：意识水平改变时 Entonox 属禁忌，意识下降或头部损伤时甲氧氟烷属禁忌——两者都不给并记录理由；对意识模糊且可能需要手术的患者不得给予任何口服药物。EMR 范围提示：EMR 层级没有静脉通路、没有补液；面对心律失常，EMR 能做的只有贴 AED 电极片、给氧和快速转运。

phases.infoEn: Notify early: electrical contact at 347 volts with entry and exit wounds across the chest, an irregular pulse, a 3.5-metre fall with LOC, immobilized. The hand-off must include voltage, current path, contact duration, LOC duration, GCS trend, the irregular rhythm and that the AED pads are on. PCR within 5 minutes; WorkSafeBC documentation matters on a workplace injury, so times and mechanism must be exact.
