criticalPitfallsEn: Approaching the patient before qualified personnel confirm the source is isolated, locked and tagged out - an apprentice saying 'I think I got the breaker' is not confirmation, and this endangers the whole crew
Not taking C-spine control after a 3.5-metre fall onto concrete with an altered LOC and a head injury - 100%
Treating the small palm burn as the whole injury and never looking for the exit wound - you miss that the current crossed the chest, which is the reason this patient can arrest
Not applying AED pads for monitoring in a patient with an irregular pulse after electrical contact
Giving Entonox or methoxyflurane despite an altered level of consciousness and head injury - contraindications not ruled out, up to 100%
Decontaminating and cooling for the whole transport - the total is capped at 15-20 minutes, and he is already on cold concrete
Splinting the wrist without checking circulation, motor and sensation before and after
criticalPitfallsZh: 在有资质人员确认电源已隔离、挂牌上锁之前就靠近患者——学徒说"我应该是拉对闸了"不算确认，这会让整个车组置身危险。
从 3.5 米坠落至水泥地、合并意识改变和头部损伤，却不实施颈椎控制——扣 100%。
把手掌上那处小烧伤当成全部损伤，从不去找出口伤——于是漏掉"电流穿过胸部"这一事实，而这正是该患者可能骤停的原因。
触电后脉律不齐却不贴 AED 电极片进行监护。
在意识水平改变合并头部损伤的情况下仍给 Entonox 或甲氧氟烷——未排除禁忌证，最高扣 100%。
整个转运过程一直冲洗降温——冲洗加降温总共不得超过 15-20 分钟，何况他已经躺在冰凉的水泥地上。
夹板固定腕部前后不检查循环、运动和感觉。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Everything this patient needs before hospital is EMR scope: scene safety discipline, spinal motion restriction, oxygen, saline decontamination and dressings for the entry and exit wounds, a wrist splint with circulation checks, AED pads for monitoring, warmth and rapid transport. The out-of-scope temptations are an IV with a fluid bolus for the shock-like presentation and any pharmacological treatment of the irregular rhythm - neither exists at EMR level. The analgesics that ARE in the EMR formulary are all ruled out here: Entonox and methoxyflurane by the altered LOC and head injury, and oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen because he is confused and heading for possible surgery. Saying that out loud and documenting it is the correct EMR answer.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这位患者到院前所需的一切都在 EMR 范围内：严格的现场安全纪律、脊柱运动限制、给氧、用生理盐水冲洗并包扎进出电伤口、腕部夹板并做循环检查、贴 AED 电极片监护、保暖以及快速转运。超范围的诱惑是：因休克样表现而建立静脉通路补液，以及用药物处理心律不齐——这两项在 EMR 层级都不存在。EMR 药物目录里"确实有"的镇痛药在本例全部被排除：Entonox 和甲氧氟烷因意识改变与头部损伤而禁忌，口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬则因患者意识模糊且可能需要手术而不适用。把这些理由说出来并记录下来，就是 EMR 的正确答案。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route and, if he becomes hypotensive, a 20 mL/kg normal saline bolus to a maximum of 2 litres reassessed every 500 mL while considering other causes of shock - an electrical patient who is hypotensive usually has another injury from the fall. PCP also completes the Functional Enquiry en route. The analgesia decision does not change: his level of consciousness rules out the inhaled agents at every licence level.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路；若出现低血压，给生理盐水 20 mL/kg（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评），同时须考虑其他休克原因——触电患者一旦低血压，通常是坠落造成了另一处损伤。PCP 还需在途中完成功能问诊。镇痛决策不变：他的意识状态在任何执照级别下都排除了吸入类镇痛药。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 38-year-old male electrician who contacted an energized 347-volt alternating current lighting panel at about 1138 today. The current entered through his right palm and exited through his left heel, so it crossed his chest, and contact lasted about two seconds. He was thrown from a ladder and fell approximately 3.5 metres onto bare concrete, landing on his back and left side; his hard hat came off and his coworker reports about one minute of loss of consciousness. He has been confused since. First vitals GCS 13, E3 V4 M6, BP 104/68, pulse 112 and irregular, respirations 24, SpO2 95 percent on room air corrected to 99 on 15 litres, glucose 5.9, temperature 36.3; latest GCS 14, BP 110/70, pulse 104 still irregular, temperature 36.0. Injuries are a 3 centimetre full-thickness entry wound to the right palm with a numb centre, a 2 centimetre exit wound on the left heel, an occipital abrasion and hematoma, mid-thoracic and C6-C7 tenderness, and a deformed left wrist splinted with an intact radial pulse. He is fully immobilized on a scoop with a collar. Treatments were oxygen at 15 litres, sterile saline decontamination of both wounds for a total of about 12 minutes, dry non-adherent dressings, wrist splint with pre and post circulation checks, AED pads applied and still on for monitoring, and blankets with the heater running. No analgesia was given because his level of consciousness contraindicates Entonox and methoxyflurane. No cardiac history, no medications, no known allergies, last ate at 0930, tetanus status unknown. I am an EMR so there is no IV.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 38 岁男性电工，今天约 11:38 接触带电的 347 伏交流照明配电盘。电流由右手掌进入、由左足跟流出，因此穿过了胸部，接触时长约两秒。他被弹出梯子，从约 3.5 米高摔到裸露水泥地上，背部和左侧着地；安全帽脱落，同事称他昏迷约一分钟，此后一直意识模糊。首组生命体征 GCS 13（E3 V4 M6）、血压 104/68、脉搏 112 且节律不齐、呼吸 24、SpO2 室内空气 95% 经 15 L 吸氧升至 99%、血糖 5.9、体温 36.3；末组 GCS 14、血压 110/70、脉搏 104 仍不规则、体温 36.0。损伤包括：右手掌 3 厘米全层入口伤（中心区麻木）、左足跟 2 厘米出口伤、枕部擦伤伴血肿、胸椎中段及 C6-C7 压痛、左腕畸形已夹板固定且桡动脉搏动完好。已戴颈托并在铲式担架上完成整体固定。已做处置：15 L 吸氧、两处伤口无菌生理盐水冲洗共约 12 分钟、覆盖不粘干敷料、腕部夹板并在固定前后检查循环、贴 AED 电极片并持续监护、加盖毯子并开启暖气。未给任何镇痛药，因为他的意识状态构成 Entonox 和甲氧氟烷的禁忌。无心脏病史、无长期用药、无已知过敏，09:30 最后进食，破伤风免疫情况不详。我是 EMR，未建立静脉通路。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: 347 V electrical contact with entry and exit wounds plus a 3.5 m fall onto concrete with loss of consciousness
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Checking a ballast on a live 347 V AC lighting panel at approximately 1138; contact about 2 seconds; entry right palm, exit left heel (current crossed the chest); thrown from ladder, fell 3.5 m onto concrete landing on back and left side; hard hat displaced; LOC about 1 minute with amnesia for the fall; pain 6/10 wrist, 3/10 hand with numb wound centre
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: No significant history, no cardiac history, tetanus status unknown
treatments: Scene entry only after fire confirmed lockout, tagout and tested dead
Manual C-spine from first contact, collar, log roll to scoop, head blocks and straps
Oxygen 15 L NRB
AED pads applied for monitoring given the irregular pulse after current crossed the chest
Sterile saline decontamination of entry and exit wounds, total cooling/decontamination about 12 minutes, then dry non-adherent dressings
Left wrist splinted in position found with circulation, motor and sensation checked before and after
Entonox and methoxyflurane withheld - altered LOC and head injury; nothing PO
Dried after decontamination, blankets and ambulance heater for hypothermia prevention
findings: GCS 13 (E3V4M6) improving to 14 (E4V4M6); confused with amnesia for the fall
Pulse 112 irregular improving to 104, still irregular - dysrhythmia risk after transthoracic current
Full-thickness entry wound right palm 3 cm with anaesthetic centre; exit wound left heel 2 cm
Right occipital abrasion and hematoma; C6-C7 and mid-thoracic midline tenderness
Deformed left wrist with radial pulse and normal capillary refill maintained after splinting

scenarios.titleEn: Rugby Collision - Clavicle and Shoulder Injury Hiding a Pneumothorax
scenarios.titleZh: 橄榄球撞击——锁骨与肩关节损伤掩盖下的气胸
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1425 hrs. Code 2 to a men's rugby match at Exhibition Park, Kamloops. A 22-year-old male winger was tackled and is holding his left shoulder; the team physiotherapist has him sitting on the sideline. Dry and 24 degrees C. Ambulance access is across 60 metres of grass. Royal Inland Hospital is 9 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:25，Code 2 前往甘露市（Kamloops）Exhibition Park 的一场男子橄榄球比赛。一名 22 岁边锋在被擒抱后捂着左肩；队医（理疗师）已让他坐在场边。天气干燥，24 摄氏度。救护车需穿过 60 米草地才能接近。皇家内陆医院车程 9 分钟。

phases.infoEn: En-route update: the physiotherapist says he thinks the collarbone is broken and the shoulder 'looks out'. The player walked off the field with help and is talking normally. On the face of it this sounds like a stable isolated extremity injury - do not let that expectation decide the call for you.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：队医说他觉得锁骨断了，肩膀"看起来脱位了"。球员是在人搀扶下自己走下场的，说话正常。表面上这听起来像一例稳定的孤立四肢损伤——但绝不要让这个先入为主的印象替你做判断。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan: full assessment including the chest, splint in the position found, analgesia if indicated, and reassess before deciding it is 'just a shoulder'
expected.actionZh: 确认出车并制定计划：完整评估（包含胸部）、按发现时姿势固定、有指征时镇痛，在下"只是肩膀问题"的结论之前先复评

expected.actionEn: Plan the 60-metre grass carry: bring the cot or a carry chair and ask the team for help
expected.actionZh: 规划 60 米草地搬运：带上担架床或搬运椅，并请球队人员协助

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a crowd, uneven turf and body fluid exposure; gloves on before contact
expected.actionZh: 预判围观人群、不平整草皮和体液暴露；接触前戴好手套

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: A crowd of teammates surrounds the patient; the physiotherapist has already put a triangular bandage on him. Dry sunny afternoon, firm turf, no hazards other than the crowd and the distance to the ambulance. One patient. He is sitting on a bench leaning slightly to the left, supporting his left arm, breathing a little fast and speaking in short phrases between breaths.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：一群队友围在患者身边；队医已经给他打好了三角巾。晴朗干燥的下午，草皮结实，除了人群和到救护车的距离外没有其他危险源。仅一名患者。他坐在长椅上、身体略向左倾，托着左臂，呼吸略快，说话时要停顿、只能一次说几个词。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (crowd control, 60 m carry), environment, MOI (high-energy tackle with a direct blow to the left chest and shoulder) and one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（人群管理、60 米搬运距离）、环境、受伤机制（高能量擒抱，左胸与左肩直接受击）与单一患者

expected.actionEn: Gloves on and move the crowd back to get room and privacy to expose the chest
expected.actionZh: 戴好手套，请围观人群后退，腾出空间和隐私以便暴露胸部检查

expected.actionEn: First look: young male sitting, leaning to the injured side, guarding the left arm, speaking in short phrases - that is a respiratory finding, not just pain
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：年轻男性坐位、向患侧倾斜、护着左臂、说话断续——这是呼吸方面的发现，而不仅仅是疼痛表现

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert, in obvious pain, breathing shallowly and splinting the left side, 'it hurts to breathe in'. EXAMINER: airway clear, speaking. Respirations 22, shallow, splinted on the left, no accessory muscle use yet. AUSCULTATE: air entry is decreased at the LEFT BASE compared with the right; the right side is clear. Trachea is midline, no JVD, no flail segment, no open wound, no subcutaneous emphysema yet. Radial pulse 96, strong, regular. Skin warm, dry, pink. Rapid body survey: obvious mid-shaft left clavicle deformity with the skin tented but not broken; the left shoulder is held slightly abducted and externally rotated with fullness anteriorly and a hollow beneath the acromion; bruising over the left lateral ribs 5 to 7; turf abrasions to the left flank; no other injuries. Distal radial pulse present on the left, capillary refill 2 seconds, but sensation is reduced over the lateral deltoid. He never lost consciousness, has no neck pain, no midline cervical tenderness, no neurological symptoms in the legs, was ambulatory off the field and can rotate his neck 45 degrees each way - the Canadian C-Spine Rule is negative. If the candidate elects to apply spinal precautions anyway because the shoulder is a distracting injury, that is defensible and is NOT penalized.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒，明显疼痛，呼吸浅、左侧受限，"吸气就疼"。考官：气道通畅，能说话。呼吸 22 次/分、浅、左侧受限，暂无辅助呼吸肌参与。听诊：左肺底进气较右侧减弱；右侧清晰。气管居中，无颈静脉怒张，无连枷胸，无开放伤口，暂无皮下气肿。桡动脉 96 次/分、有力、规则。皮肤温暖干燥、颜色红润。快速查体：左锁骨中段明显畸形，皮肤被顶起但未破；左肩略外展外旋位，肩前方饱满、肩峰下方凹陷；左侧第 5 至 7 肋区瘀斑；左侧腰腹部草皮擦伤；无其他损伤。左侧桡动脉搏动可及，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒，但三角肌外侧区感觉减退。他全程未昏迷、无颈部疼痛、颈椎中线无压痛、双下肢无神经症状、能自行走下场、颈部可左右各旋转 45 度——加拿大颈椎规则为阴性。若考生因肩部为"分散注意力的损伤"而仍选择实施脊柱固定，属于可辩护的做法，不予扣分。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert（清醒）

expected.actionEn: Assess and document the cervical spine deliberately (mechanism, midline tenderness, neurology, ambulation, rotation) and state your decision with the rationale
expected.actionZh: 有意识地评估并记录颈椎情况（受伤机制、中线压痛、神经体征、是否能行走、旋转活动度），并说明你的决定及理由

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing properly and AUSCULTATE BOTH SIDES - the decreased air entry at the left base is the finding this whole call turns on
expected.actionZh: 规范评估呼吸并双侧听诊——左肺底进气减弱是整场处置的转折点

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation
expected.actionZh: 评估循环

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey: expose the chest, find the rib bruising, the clavicle deformity and the shoulder deformity, and check distal circulation, motor and sensation in the left arm
expected.actionZh: 快速查体：暴露胸部，发现肋部瘀斑、锁骨畸形与肩关节畸形，并检查左臂远端循环、运动和感觉

expected.actionEn: Note skin: warm, dry, pink at this stage
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：此阶段温暖、干燥、红润

expected.actionEn: Oxygen - trauma with a chest injury and abnormal air entry; start with a non-rebreather at 15 L and titrate to his condition
expected.actionZh: 给氧——胸部创伤且进气异常；先用 15 L 非再吸入面罩，再依据病情调整

expected.actionEn: Position sitting up or in the position of comfort - a chest trauma patient should be positioned as soon as possible
expected.actionZh: 取坐位或舒适体位——胸部创伤患者应尽早摆好体位

expected.actionEn: Support the left arm in the position found; do NOT attempt to reduce the dislocation
expected.actionZh: 按发现时的姿势托住左臂；不得尝试复位脱臼的肩关节

phases.infoEn: Decision point, and this is the trap. The call was dispatched as a shoulder injury and everything about the setting says 'stable non-priority'. But respiratory distress with shallow splinted breathing and decreased air entry after a direct blow to the chest is a finding in an UNSTABLE patient. The correct category is RTC, ready to load within 15 minutes, and the reassessment interval tightens to every 7-8 minutes. A candidate who logs this as non-RTC because 'it is just a clavicle' takes the transport deduction and will usually also be late recognizing the deterioration.
phases.infoZh: 决策点，也是本例的陷阱所在。出车指令说的是肩部损伤，现场的一切也都在暗示"稳定、非优先"。但胸部直接受击后出现浅快受限的呼吸并伴进气减弱，属于不稳定患者的表现。正确分类是 RTC，15 分钟内打包完毕，复评间隔也随之缩短为每 7-8 分钟一次。若考生因为"不就是根锁骨吗"而记为非 RTC，不但要吃转运分类的扣分，通常也会延迟发现病情恶化。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC because of respiratory distress and decreased air entry after chest trauma, not because of the fracture
expected.actionZh: 因胸部创伤后出现呼吸窘迫和进气减弱而判为 RTC，而不是因为骨折

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes including the 60-metre carry
expected.actionZh: 含 60 米搬运在内，15 分钟内打包完毕可装载

expected.actionEn: Use the team to help with the carry and keep the crowd back; notify the hospital of a suspected pneumothorax
expected.actionZh: 利用球队人员协助搬运并让围观者保持距离；向医院预报疑似气胸

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: he was tackled at full speed about six minutes ago; his left shoulder hit the ground first and the tackler's knee drove into his left ribs at the same time. He felt and heard a crack. No head strike, no loss of consciousness, no neck pain. Pain 8/10 in the shoulder, and a separate sharp 6/10 pain in the left ribs that is worse on deep breath. He has been short of breath since the tackle. PMHx: he dislocated this same left shoulder two years ago and it was put back in at the hospital; nothing else, no asthma. Meds: none regularly - he took 400 mg of ibuprofen at 0730 this morning for a sore knee. Allergies: none known. LOI: pasta at 1130 and water during the game.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：大约 6 分钟前他在全速跑动中被擒抱；左肩先着地，同时对方的膝盖顶在他左侧肋骨上。他当时听到并感觉到"咔"的一声。头部未受撞击，无昏迷，无颈部疼痛。肩部疼痛 8/10；左侧肋骨另有一处 6/10 的锐痛，深吸气时加重。被擒抱后一直感觉气短。既往史：两年前同一侧左肩曾脱位，在医院复位；此外无其他病史，无哮喘。用药：无长期用药——今天早上 07:30 因膝盖酸痛服过 400 mg 布洛芬。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：11:30 意面，比赛期间喝过水。

expected.actionEn: Confirm the chief complaint - and note that he gives you TWO complaints: the shoulder and the ribs with breathlessness
expected.actionZh: 确认主诉——并注意他其实说了两个主诉：肩部，以及肋部疼痛伴气短

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST for both pains: exact mechanism, what struck the chest, time of injury, whether the breathlessness started at impact or afterwards, any head strike or LOC
expected.actionZh: 对两处疼痛分别用 OPQRRRST 采集现病史：确切机制、胸部被什么击中、受伤时间、气短是撞击当时就有还是之后出现、有无头部撞击或昏迷

expected.actionEn: Pain scores recorded separately for the shoulder and the chest
expected.actionZh: 分别记录肩部与胸部的疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx: previous dislocation of the same shoulder, no asthma or lung disease
expected.actionZh: 既往史：同侧肩关节既往脱位史，无哮喘或肺部疾病

expected.actionEn: Medications: ask specifically what analgesia he has already taken today and at what time, because it changes what you can give
expected.actionZh: 用药史：必须具体询问今天已经吃过什么镇痛药、几点吃的，因为这直接决定你还能给什么

expected.actionEn: Allergies: none known
expected.actionZh: 过敏史：无已知过敏

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后进食时间

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (1434, on the sideline, before oxygen): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 132/80; pulse 96 strong regular; respirations 22 shallow and splinted on the left; skin warm dry pink; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 96% on room air, rising to 99% on 15 L; BGL not indicated; temperature not indicated. Air entry decreased at the left base, trachea midline, no JVD.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（14:34，场边，给氧前）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 132/80；脉搏 96 有力规则；呼吸 22 次/分、浅且左侧受限；皮肤温暖干燥红润；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 96%，吸 15 L 氧后升至 99%；血糖无指征；体温无指征。左肺底进气减弱，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及三个分项

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure on the uninjured right arm
expected.actionZh: 在未受伤的右臂测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations with a full description - rate, depth, splinting and air entry compared side to side
expected.actionZh: 完整描述呼吸——频率、深度、是否受限，并左右对比进气情况

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手评估皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 on the uninjured hand, recorded before and after oxygen
expected.actionZh: 在未受伤的手上测 SpO2，并分别记录给氧前后的数值

expected.actionEn: Baseline vitals must be complete BEFORE any analgesia protocol is started
expected.actionZh: 在启动任何镇痛方案之前，必须先完成完整的基线生命体征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route. ACTOR: general - fit, trains four times a week, no illnesses; CNS - no LOC, no headache, no numbness in the legs, but the outside of the left shoulder feels numb; respiratory - short of breath since the tackle, hurts to take a deep breath, no cough, no blood; cardiovascular - heart is pounding, no chest pressure; GI/GU - nothing; integumentary - turf abrasions on the left flank; musculoskeletal - the left shoulder and collarbone, previous dislocation of the same shoulder; endocrine - nothing; EENT - nothing.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中进行。患者演员：整体——身体健康，每周训练四次，无疾病；中枢神经——无昏迷、无头痛、双下肢无麻木，但左肩外侧发麻；呼吸——被擒抱后一直气短、深吸气疼、无咳嗽、无咯血；心血管——心跳很重、无胸闷压迫感；消化/泌尿——无异常；皮肤——左侧腰腹草皮擦伤；肌肉骨骼——左肩与锁骨，同侧肩关节既往脱位；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (numbness over the lateral deltoid suggests axillary nerve involvement)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经系统（三角肌外侧麻木提示腋神经受累）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (the key system in this call)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸系统（本例的关键系统）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管系统

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼系统

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌系统

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe (started on scene, completed en route): head and neck - no injury, no midline cervical tenderness, full pain-free rotation; chest - bruising over the left lateral ribs 5 to 7 with point tenderness, no flail segment, air entry decreased at the left base on the first look and decreased throughout the left field on recheck, fine crepitus appearing over the left lateral chest wall on the second exam, trachea still midline; abdomen - soft, non-tender, turf abrasion to the left flank; back - no tenderness or deformity; upper extremities - mid-shaft left clavicle deformity with tented skin, left shoulder abducted and externally rotated with anterior fullness and a hollow under the acromion, radial pulse present, capillary refill 2 seconds, reduced sensation over the lateral deltoid, right arm normal; lower extremities - normal.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚检查（现场开始、途中完成）：头颈——无损伤，颈椎中线无压痛，旋转活动充分且无痛；胸部——左侧第 5 至 7 肋区瘀斑伴局部压痛，无连枷段，首次检查时左肺底进气减弱，复查时整个左肺野进气均减弱，第二次查体时左侧胸壁出现细捻发感（皮下气肿），气管仍居中；腹部——柔软无压痛，左侧腰腹草皮擦伤；背部——无压痛无畸形；上肢——左锁骨中段畸形、皮肤被顶起，左肩外展外旋、肩前饱满、肩峰下凹陷，桡动脉搏动可及，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒，三角肌外侧感觉减退，右臂正常；下肢——正常。

expected.actionZh: 头颈查体，含颈椎中线触诊

expected.actionEn: Chest examination with auscultation at six sites and palpation for crepitus - repeat it, because the findings change
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体：6 个部位听诊并触诊有无捻发感——必须复查，因为体征会变化

expected.actionEn: Abdominal examination
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back examination
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionZh: 上肢：锁骨、肩关节位置，以及固定前后的循环、运动与感觉

phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Musculoskeletal: immobilize the clavicle and the dislocated shoulder in the position found with a sling and swathe, padding the gap between the arm and the chest wall; never attempt to reduce a dislocation, and never force the arm against the chest; check circulation, motor and sensation before and after; apply cold to the clavicle only if the distal circulation is not impaired. Chest trauma: assist oxygenation, position him upright, and watch relentlessly for tension pneumothorax - increasing distress, absent air entry on the left, tracheal deviation away, distended neck veins, falling blood pressure. ANALGESIA IS THE EXAM POINT: Entonox is ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED because a pneumothorax is on its contraindication list, and nitrous oxide expands a closed air space. You must auscultate the chest BEFORE reaching for the Entonox. Acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO are both indicated and permitted here - he last took ibuprofen at 0730, well beyond the 4-6 hour interval, he is not on anticoagulants and has no GI bleeding - and giving only one of the two costs marks. Methoxyflurane is best discussed with medical direction rather than used by default in a patient whose respiratory status is deteriorating. Document clearly why Entonox was withheld, or the examiner will score it as analgesia omitted. EMR SCOPE NOTE: EMR does not decompress a chest and does not start an IV - oxygen, position, monitoring and speed are the treatment.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。肌肉骨骼：用三角巾加固定带按发现时的姿势固定锁骨与脱位的肩关节，在上臂与胸壁之间垫好衬垫；绝不尝试复位脱臼，绝不强行把手臂压向胸壁；固定前后检查循环、运动与感觉；仅在远端循环未受影响时对锁骨处冷敷。胸部创伤：辅助氧合、取坐位，并持续警惕张力性气胸——呼吸窘迫加重、左侧进气消失、气管向对侧移位、颈静脉怒张、血压下降。镇痛是本例考点：Entonox 属绝对禁忌，因为气胸就在其禁忌清单上，且一氧化二氮会使封闭气腔膨胀。伸手去拿 Entonox 之前，必须先听诊胸部。对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服和布洛芬 400 mg 口服在本例都有指征且允许使用——他上次服布洛芬是 07:30，早已超过 4-6 小时间隔，未使用抗凝药，也无消化道出血——两者只给其中一种是要扣分的。甲氧氟烷在呼吸状况正在恶化的患者中不宜默认使用，应先与医疗指导沟通。务必清楚记录不给 Entonox 的理由，否则考官会按"未给镇痛"计分。EMR 范围提示：EMR 不做胸腔减压、不建立静脉通路——给氧、体位、监护和速度就是治疗。

expected.actionEn: Fracture management skill: sling and swathe supporting the clavicle and shoulder in the position found, padded, with circulation, motor and sensation checked before and after
expected.actionZh: 骨折处理技能：用三角巾加固定带按发现时姿势托住锁骨与肩关节，加好衬垫，并在固定前后检查循环、运动与感觉

expected.actionEn: Breathing management skill: high-flow oxygen, upright positioning, and continuous monitoring for a developing tension pneumothorax
expected.actionZh: 呼吸管理技能：高流量吸氧、取坐位，并持续监测是否发展为张力性气胸

expected.actionEn: Wound management skill: clean and dress the turf abrasions once the priorities are handled
expected.actionZh: 伤口处理技能：在处理完优先事项后清洁并包扎草皮擦伤

expected.actionEn: Withhold Entonox and say why - pneumothorax is an absolute contraindication and nitrous oxide expands a closed air space
expected.actionZh: 不给 Entonox 并说明理由——气胸是绝对禁忌，一氧化二氮会使封闭气腔膨胀

expected.actionEn: Give BOTH acetaminophen 1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 400 mg PO after confirming the last dose times, with the six rights and a documented reassessment
expected.actionZh: 在确认末次服药时间后，同时给予对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 口服和布洛芬 400 mg 口服，执行六项核对并记录复评

expected.actionEn: Do not attempt to reduce the dislocation - that is outside EMR scope and can jeopardize the limb
expected.actionZh: 不得尝试复位脱臼——这超出 EMR 授权范围，并可能危及肢体

phases.infoEn: This is where the call is won or lost - he is deteriorating and only reassessment will show it. Recheck the ABCs and auscultate after the carry, after loading, and every few minutes. Set 2 (1446, en route, on 15 L): GCS 15 but anxious and wanting to sit further up; BP 118/76; pulse 118 regular; respirations 30, shallow, now using accessory muscles; skin pale, cool, clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 90% on 15 L; air entry now markedly decreased throughout the LEFT field with new fine crepitus over the left chest wall; trachea still midline and no JVD - it is not tension yet, but it is heading there. Upgrade the notification, keep him upright, keep the oxygen at 15 L, and be ready to assist ventilation.
phases.infoZh: 本场处置的成败就在这一幕——他正在恶化，而只有复评才能发现。搬运后、装车后以及每隔数分钟都要复评 ABC 并听诊。第 2 组（14:46，途中，15 L 吸氧中）：GCS 15 但焦虑、要求把上身摇得更高；血压 118/76；脉搏 118 规则；呼吸 30 次/分、浅，已开始动用辅助呼吸肌；皮肤苍白、湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 15 L 下 90%；左肺野整体进气明显减弱，左胸壁新出现细捻发感；气管仍居中、无颈静脉怒张——尚未形成张力性气胸，但正在向那个方向发展。升级预报、保持坐位、维持 15 L 吸氧，并做好辅助通气的准备。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and re-auscultate both lungs after every move and every few minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后及每隔数分钟复评 ABC 并重新听诊双肺

expected.actionEn: Second complete set of vitals within 7-8 minutes and state the deteriorating trend out loud
expected.actionZh: 7-8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头指出恶化趋势

expected.actionEn: Actively look for tension pneumothorax signs: tracheal deviation, JVD, absent air entry, falling blood pressure, and report them if they appear
expected.actionZh: 主动查找张力性气胸的体征：气管移位、颈静脉怒张、进气消失、血压下降，一旦出现立即上报

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain and the effect of the analgesia already given, and reconfirm that Entonox stays withheld
expected.actionZh: 复评疼痛及已给镇痛药的效果，并再次确认继续不给 Entonox

expected.actionEn: Recheck circulation, motor and sensation in the splinted arm after each move
expected.actionZh: 每次移动后复查已固定手臂的循环、运动与感觉

phases.infoEn: Notify Royal Inland Hospital that you are bringing a young chest trauma patient with a suspected pneumothorax that is worsening en route, plus a clavicle fracture and shoulder dislocation. The hand-off must give the trend, not just the numbers: what the air entry was when you arrived and what it is now. PCR within 5 minutes, documenting the analgesia given, and the reason Entonox was withheld.
phases.infoZh: 向皇家内陆医院预报：你正在送来一名年轻胸部创伤患者，疑似气胸且途中持续加重，另有锁骨骨折和肩关节脱位。交接必须讲清"变化趋势"而不只是数字：你到场时进气情况如何、现在又如何。PCR 在 5 分钟内完成，记录已给的镇痛药，以及不给 Entonox 的理由。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification stating a suspected pneumothorax that is worsening
expected.actionZh: 途中预报，明确说明疑似气胸且正在加重

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off giving the air entry and vital sign TREND, the neurological finding at the deltoid, and the analgesia decisions
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，说明进气与生命体征的变化趋势、三角肌处的神经学发现，以及镇痛用药决策

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes documenting drug times and the Entonox contraindication
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR，记录给药时间与 Entonox 的禁忌理由

vitalsSets.resp: 22 shallow, splinted on the left, air entry decreased at left base
30 shallow with accessory muscle use, air entry markedly decreased throughout the left field, new crepitus

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving Entonox for an 'isolated extremity injury' without auscultating the chest first - pneumothorax is an absolute contraindication and nitrous oxide expands the air space, so this is a protocol failure up to 100%
Never auscultating both lungs at all, so the decreased air entry is missed and the whole call is treated as a shoulder injury
Categorizing as non-RTC because the fracture looks isolated, despite respiratory distress after chest trauma - 25% plus everything that follows from moving too slowly
Attempting to reduce the shoulder dislocation - outside EMR scope and may jeopardize the limb
Splinting without checking circulation, motor and sensation before and after, and missing the numb lateral deltoid
Taking one set of vitals and never repeating them, so the deterioration from 22 to 30 respirations and SpO2 99 to 90 is discovered by the triage nurse instead of by you
Giving only acetaminophen or only ibuprofen when both are indicated and permitted - a straight pain-management deduction
criticalPitfallsZh: 把它当成"孤立四肢损伤"、不先听诊胸部就给 Entonox——气胸是绝对禁忌，一氧化二氮还会让气腔膨胀，属于协议失败，最高扣 100%。
根本没有双肺听诊，于是漏掉进气减弱，整场按肩部损伤处理。
因为骨折"看起来是孤立的"就判为非 RTC，而无视胸部创伤后的呼吸窘迫——扣 25%，还要承担因动作过慢带来的后续一切后果。
尝试给肩关节复位——超出 EMR 授权范围，并可能危及肢体。
固定前后不检查循环、运动和感觉，漏掉三角肌外侧的感觉减退。
只测一组生命体征、从不复测，结果呼吸由 22 升到 30、SpO2 由 99 掉到 90 这一恶化过程是分诊护士发现的，而不是你发现的。
在两种药都有指征且允许使用时只给对乙酰氨基酚或只给布洛芬——直接触发疼痛管理扣分。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: This call is entirely within EMR scope and it is a pure test of assessment discipline: auscultate before you medicate, reassess before you relax. EMR does everything that matters here - oxygen, upright positioning, sling and swathe in the position found with circulation checks, cold to the clavicle, acetaminophen and ibuprofen by mouth, withholding Entonox for the pneumothorax, continuous reassessment for tension, and an RTC transport. The out-of-scope temptations are chest decompression, an IV, and any thought of reducing the dislocation. Note that EMR cannot decompress a tension pneumothorax at all, which is exactly why early recognition, high-flow oxygen and rapid transport are the entire plan.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一例完全在 EMR 授权范围内，考的是纯粹的评估纪律：先听诊再给药，先复评再放松。真正起作用的处置 EMR 全都能做——给氧、坐位、按发现姿势用三角巾加固定带并检查循环、锁骨处冷敷、口服对乙酰氨基酚与布洛芬、因气胸而不给 Entonox、持续复评是否发展为张力性气胸，以及按 RTC 转运。超范围的诱惑是胸腔减压、建立静脉通路，以及任何想给肩关节复位的念头。要特别记住：EMR 根本无法为张力性气胸减压，正因如此，早期识别、高流量吸氧和快速转运就是全部计划。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access en route and completes the Functional Enquiry, and can consider IV acetaminophen if the oral route is not tolerated. The analgesia reasoning is identical at both levels: Entonox is contraindicated by the pneumothorax regardless of licence. A PCP also carries a higher index of suspicion for progression to tension and will communicate that clearly on the notification so the receiving team is ready.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路并完成功能问诊，若口服途径不耐受可考虑静脉对乙酰氨基酚。两个级别的镇痛推理完全一致：无论执照级别如何，气胸都构成 Entonox 的禁忌。PCP 还应对进展为张力性气胸保持更高的警觉，并在预报中明确说明，以便接收团队提前做好准备。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 22-year-old male rugby player tackled at about 1428. His left shoulder hit the ground and the tackler's knee struck his left lateral chest at the same time. He has an obvious mid-shaft left clavicle deformity with tented skin and an anterior dislocation of the left shoulder, with reduced sensation over the lateral deltoid, but a good radial pulse and 2-second capillary refill throughout. The important part is his chest: he had bruising over the left ribs 5 to 7 and decreased air entry at the left base on my first assessment at 1434, with respirations of 22 and SpO2 96 percent on room air. By 1446 he was at 30 respirations with accessory muscle use, SpO2 90 percent on 15 litres, pulse up from 96 to 118, air entry markedly decreased throughout the left field and new crepitus over the left chest wall. Trachea is midline and there is no JVD, so I do not have a tension yet, but he is trending that way. He is on 15 litres by non-rebreather, sitting upright, with the arm immobilized in the position found. He had acetaminophen 1 gram and ibuprofen 400 milligrams by mouth at 1440 - his previous ibuprofen was at 0730 this morning. I did NOT give Entonox because of the suspected pneumothorax. No LOC, no neck pain, Canadian C-Spine Rule negative. No medical history other than a previous dislocation of the same shoulder, no allergies, last ate at 1130. I am an EMR.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 22 岁男性橄榄球运动员，约 14:28 被擒抱受伤。左肩着地，同时对方膝盖撞击其左侧胸壁。他左锁骨中段明显畸形、皮肤被顶起，左肩前脱位，三角肌外侧感觉减退，但桡动脉搏动良好、毛细血管再充盈全程 2 秒。关键在胸部：14:34 我首次评估时，左侧第 5 至 7 肋区有瘀斑、左肺底进气减弱，呼吸 22，室内空气 SpO2 96%。到 14:46，呼吸已升至 30 次/分并动用辅助呼吸肌，15 L 吸氧下 SpO2 90%，脉搏由 96 升至 118，整个左肺野进气明显减弱，左胸壁新出现捻发感。气管居中、无颈静脉怒张，因此尚未形成张力性气胸，但正朝那个方向发展。目前 15 L 非再吸入面罩吸氧、坐位，患肢已按发现时姿势固定。14:40 已口服对乙酰氨基酚 1 克和布洛芬 400 毫克——他上一次服布洛芬是今天早上 07:30。因疑似气胸，我没有给 Entonox。无昏迷、无颈部疼痛，加拿大颈椎规则阴性。除同侧肩关节既往脱位外无其他病史，无过敏，11:30 最后进食。我是 EMR。

scenarios.titleEn: Dog Bite to the Forearm - Elderly Patient on an Anticoagulant
scenarios.titleZh: 前臂犬咬伤——服用抗凝药的老年患者
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1610 hrs. Code 2 to a single-storey house in Saanich. A 78-year-old woman was bitten on the left forearm by her son's German Shepherd while trying to separate it from her own small dog. Her son called and says the bleeding 'will not stop'. Victoria General Hospital is 15 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 16:10，Code 2 前往萨尼奇（Saanich）一栋平房。一名 78 岁女性在试图把儿子的德国牧羊犬和自家小狗分开时，左前臂被咬伤。她儿子打的电话，说血"一直止不住"。维多利亚综合医院车程 15 分钟。

phases.infoEn: En-route update: the son says he has put the German Shepherd outside in the fenced back yard and the door is closed. The patient is anxious, mainly about what will happen to the dog. Dispatch has notified the police, who will pass it to animal control.
phases.infoZh: 途中调度更新：儿子说他已经把德国牧羊犬赶到围起来的后院并关上了门。患者情绪焦虑，主要是担心那条狗会被怎么处理。调度已通知警方，警方会转交动物管理部门。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan: confirm the dog is secured before entry, then bleeding control, wound care, analgesia and a full geriatric assessment
expected.actionZh: 确认出车并制定计划：进门前先确认狗已被关好，然后依次是止血、伤口处理、镇痛和完整的老年患者评估

expected.actionEn: Anticipate an anticoagulated elderly patient: bleeding that is slow to stop, fragile skin, and the need to ask about blood thinners early
expected.actionZh: 预判这是一位使用抗凝药的老年患者：出血难止、皮肤脆弱，须尽早询问抗凝药情况

expected.actionEn: Anticipate the animal hazard and blood exposure; gloves and eye protection before entering
expected.actionZh: 预判动物伤人风险与血液暴露；进门前戴好手套与护目镜

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The son meets you at the door. If the candidate asks, he confirms the German Shepherd is in the back yard behind a closed and latched door and the small dog is shut in a bedroom - only then is the scene safe. If the candidate walks in without asking about the dogs, record it as a scene-safety failure. Inside, the patient is sitting at the kitchen table with a blood-soaked tea towel wrapped around her left forearm; there is blood on the floor and on the table, perhaps 200 mL in total. She is alert, tearful, and says 'he did not mean it, please do not take him away'. Good lighting, clear path to the door, one patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：儿子在门口迎接。若考生主动询问，他确认德国牧羊犬在后院、门已关好并上闩，小狗被关在卧室里——此时现场才算安全。若考生不问狗的情况就直接进屋，记为现场安全失败。屋内患者坐在餐桌旁，左前臂裹着一条被血浸透的擦碗布；地板和桌面上有血，总量约 200 mL。她清醒、含泪，说"它不是故意的，请不要把它带走"。照明良好，通往门口的路径畅通，仅一名患者。

expected.actionEn: Confirm both dogs are secured behind a closed door BEFORE entering - a bitten dog owner's home is an animal hazard until proven otherwise
expected.actionZh: 进门前先确认两条狗都已被关在关闭的门后——在未证实之前，发生咬伤的养犬家庭就是动物伤人风险现场

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (dogs, blood on the floor), environment (private home, clear exit path), MOI (dog bite while separating two animals) and one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（犬只、地面血迹）、环境（私人住宅、撤离路径通畅）、受伤机制（分开两只动物时被犬咬伤）与单一患者

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and oriented, upset, holding the towel on her arm. EXAMINER: airway clear, speaking in full sentences. Respirations 18, unlaboured, chest clear. Radial pulse 92 and IRREGULARLY IRREGULAR - she is in chronic atrial fibrillation. Skin warm, dry, slightly pale. When the towel is lifted, there is steady venous oozing from four puncture wounds and two lacerations of 3 cm and 5 cm on the left forearm, plus a 6 x 4 cm skin flap avulsed on the dorsal forearm - it slows and stops with direct pressure over gauze and elevation. There is NO arterial spurting and NO indication for a tourniquet. Rapid body survey: skin tears on the right forearm from the dog's paws, a bruise on the left shin, no other injuries. She did NOT fall and did not hit her head; there is no indication for spinal precautions. Distal pulse, capillary refill, movement and sensation in the left hand are all normal. STABLE.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常、情绪不安，手按着裹在臂上的毛巾。考官：气道通畅，能整句说话。呼吸 18 次/分、不费力，肺部清晰。桡动脉 92 次/分、绝对不齐——她有慢性心房颤动。皮肤温暖干燥、略显苍白。掀开毛巾可见左前臂四处穿刺伤和两处 3 厘米、5 厘米的裂伤持续静脉性渗血，前臂背侧另有一块 6×4 厘米的撕脱皮瓣——隔纱布直接加压并抬高患肢后渗血减缓并停止。没有动脉性喷射出血，没有使用止血带的指征。快速查体：右前臂有被狗爪抓出的皮肤撕裂，左小腿有一处瘀斑，无其他损伤。她没有摔倒、头部未受撞击，无脊柱固定指征。左手远端脉搏、毛细血管再充盈、活动与感觉均正常。判定：稳定。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. She is stable: alert, no airway or breathing problem, controllable bleeding, no shock, no spinal indication - this is a NON-RTC patient with 30 minutes to package. That does not mean she can stay home. She is anticoagulated, a dog bite is a contaminated wound with a real infection risk, deep punctures can involve tendons, and her tetanus status is out of date. EXAMINER: she initially says 'can you just bandage it up, my son can drive me tomorrow'. The candidate must explain the risks in plain language, involve the son, and obtain her consent to be transported. She agrees when the reasons are explained properly.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。她病情稳定：清醒、无气道或呼吸问题、出血可控、无休克、无脊柱固定指征——属于非 RTC 患者，有 30 分钟完成打包。但这不等于她可以留在家里。她在服用抗凝药；犬咬伤属污染伤口、感染风险确实存在；深部穿刺伤可能伤及肌腱；她的破伤风免疫也早已过期。考官：她一开始说"你就帮我包一下吧，明天让我儿子送我去"。考生必须用通俗语言解释风险、争取儿子配合，并取得她同意转运。只要理由解释到位，她会同意。

The Shepherd is up to date on its shots according to her son, and it is not a stray. She did not fall and did not hit her head. Pain 6/10, throbbing, worse when the arm hangs down. PMHx: atrial fibrillation, chronic kidney disease stage 3, high blood pressure, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis. Meds: apixaban 5 mg twice daily, metoprolol, amlodipine, and she took two extra-strength Tylenol - 1000 mg of acetaminophen - at 1500 for her arthritis. Allergies: penicillin, which gives her hives. phases.infoEn: Treatments and protocols. Wound care for a stable patient: irrigate the wounds gently with sterile saline to remove gross contamination, lay the avulsed skin flap back into its anatomical position - never discard it - cover with sterile non-adherent dressings, and secure with a tubular or roller bandage rather than tape on the skin, because tape will tear fragile elderly skin when it is removed. Do not close, glue or pack a bite wound. Elevate the limb and apply cold only if the distal circulation is not impaired. Reassess the dressing for strike-through - she is anticoagulated and slow oozing can restart. ANALGESIA IS THE EXAM POINT AND EVERY OPTION MUST BE REASONED OUT LOUD: acetaminophen is CONTRAINDICATED because she took 1000 mg at 1500, well inside the four-hour interval; ibuprofen is CONTRAINDICATED because she takes apixaban, an anticoagulant; methoxyflurane is CONTRAINDICATED because of her chronic kidney disease; Entonox has NO contraindication here - she is alert, cooperative, has no pneumothorax, no facial injury and has taken no nitroglycerin - so Entonox is the correct choice, self-administered, with the cylinder inverted three times and the treatment area ventilated. Failing to offer Entonox when it is indicated is a pain-management deduction of 25%.
phases.infoZh: 处置与协议。稳定患者的伤口处理：用无菌生理盐水轻柔冲洗去除明显污染物；把撕脱的皮瓣按解剖位置复位铺平——绝不能丢弃；覆盖无菌不粘敷料；用管状绷带或卷带固定，不要把胶布直接贴在皮肤上，因为撕除胶布会把老年人脆弱的皮肤一起撕破。咬伤伤口不做缝合、不用皮肤胶、不做填塞。抬高患肢；仅在远端循环未受影响时冷敷。反复检查敷料有无渗透——她在抗凝状态，缓慢渗血可能再次出现。镇痛是本例考点，每一个选项都必须口头推理：对乙酰氨基酚属禁忌，因为她 15:00 已服 1000 mg，远在 4 小时间隔之内；布洛芬属禁忌，因为她在服抗凝药阿哌沙班；甲氧氟烷属禁忌，因为她有慢性肾病；Entonox 在本例没有任何禁忌——她清醒、配合、无气胸、无面部损伤、近期未用硝酸甘油——所以 Entonox 是正确选择，由患者自行吸入，用前将气瓶倒置三次并保证治疗空间通风。有指征却不提供 Entonox，将按疼痛管理规则扣 25%。

criticalPitfallsEn: Walking into the house without confirming that the dog is secured behind a closed door - a scene-safety failure that has ended with paramedics being bitten
Giving acetaminophen without asking what she has already taken - she had 1000 mg at 1500, so a second dose inside four hours is a contraindicated administration and a protocol error up to 100%
Giving ibuprofen to a patient on apixaban - anticoagulants are a listed contraindication
Giving methoxyflurane despite her chronic kidney disease - clinically significant renal impairment is a listed contraindication
Giving no analgesia at all when Entonox is available and has no contraindication in this patient - a 25% pain-management deduction
Reaching for a tourniquet for venous oozing that direct pressure and elevation control - escalating past what the bleeding requires
Discarding the avulsed skin flap or taping dressings directly onto fragile elderly skin
Calling this RTC because there is a lot of blood on the floor, when she meets no unstable criteria
Accepting 'I will go tomorrow' without explaining the infection, bleeding and tetanus risks and documenting the discussion
criticalPitfallsZh: 不确认狗是否被关在关闭的门后就进屋——这是现场安全失败，现实中已有救护员因此被咬伤。
不问她今天已经吃过什么就给对乙酰氨基酚——她 15:00 已服 1000 mg，4 小时内再给一剂属禁忌给药，协议错误最高扣 100%。
给正在服用阿哌沙班的患者用布洛芬——抗凝药是明列的禁忌。
无视慢性肾病仍给甲氧氟烷——有临床意义的肾功能损害是明列的禁忌。
在 Entonox 可用且该患者没有任何禁忌的情况下完全不给镇痛——按疼痛管理规则扣 25%。
对直接加压加抬高即可控制的静脉性渗血却去拿止血带——止血手段升级超过了出血本身的需要。
把撕脱的皮瓣丢弃，或把胶布直接贴在老年人脆弱的皮肤上。
因为地上血多就判为 RTC，而她其实不符合任何不稳定标准。
对"我明天再去"照单全收，不解释感染、出血和破伤风风险，也不记录这次沟通。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Every intervention this patient needs is EMR scope, and the exam value of the call is drug reasoning rather than dramatic skills. Direct pressure, a pressure dressing, elevation, saline irrigation, flap replacement, non-adherent dressings, cold, and gentle handling of fragile skin are all EMR-level wound care. The analgesia decision is where candidates fail: acetaminophen, ibuprofen and methoxyflurane are all in the EMR formulary and all three are contraindicated in THIS patient, while Entonox is in the EMR formulary and is indicated - you must be able to say why for each one. The out-of-scope temptations are an IV, ondansetron for her nausea and dimenhydrinate or diphenhydramine 'because she is upset' - all PCP-only, none of them an EMR answer.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这位患者所需的每一项处置都在 EMR 范围内，本例的考试价值在于用药推理而不是惊心动魄的技能操作。直接加压、加压包扎、抬高患肢、生理盐水冲洗、皮瓣复位、不粘敷料、冷敷，以及对脆弱皮肤的轻柔处理，全部属于 EMR 级别的伤口护理。考生真正翻车的地方是镇痛决策：对乙酰氨基酚、布洛芬和甲氧氟烷都在 EMR 药物目录内，而在"这位"患者身上三者全部禁忌；Entonox 同样在 EMR 目录内，且有指征——你必须能逐一说清理由。超范围的诱惑是建立静脉通路、用昂丹司琼止吐，以及"因为她情绪不好"就给茶苯海明或苯海拉明——这些都是 PCP 专属，没有一项是 EMR 的答案。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access if it were needed - it is not in a stable patient with controlled bleeding - and completes the Functional Enquiry, which is worth doing thoroughly here because there is time and because a geriatric patient's baseline function is part of the clinical picture. A PCP could give ondansetron if she became nauseated from the Entonox. The wound care and the analgesia reasoning are identical: her acetaminophen timing, her anticoagulant and her kidney disease rule out the same three drugs at both licence levels.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加静脉通路——但在出血已控制的稳定患者身上并不需要——并完成功能问诊；本例时间充裕，且老年患者的基线功能状态本身就是临床图景的一部分，因此值得认真做完。若她因使用 Entonox 而恶心，PCP 可以给昂丹司琼。伤口处理和镇痛推理完全一致：她的对乙酰氨基酚服药时间、抗凝药和肾病，在两个执照级别上排除的都是同样这三种药。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 78-year-old woman bitten on the left forearm by her son's German Shepherd at about 1600 while separating it from her own small dog. She has four puncture wounds, a 3 centimetre and a 5 centimetre laceration, and a 6 by 4 centimetre avulsed skin flap on the dorsal forearm which I have replaced anatomically; there are also two superficial skin tears on the right forearm and a bruise to the left shin. She did not fall and did not hit her head. Bleeding was venous and steady, controlled with direct pressure, a pressure dressing and elevation, and the dressing has stayed dry since; estimated blood loss on scene 200 millilitres. First vitals GCS 15, BP 152/88, pulse 92 irregularly irregular, respirations 18, SpO2 96 percent on room air, temperature 36.6; latest BP 144/84, pulse 88, SpO2 97, temperature 36.7. Her history is atrial fibrillation, stage 3 chronic kidney disease, hypertension, osteoarthritis and osteoporosis. She takes apixaban 5 milligrams twice daily, metoprolol and amlodipine, and importantly she took 1000 milligrams of acetaminophen at 1500. She is allergic to penicillin - hives. Her tetanus is out of date, probably more than ten years. For analgesia I withheld acetaminophen because of the 1500 dose, ibuprofen because of the apixaban, and methoxyflurane because of her kidney disease; I gave Entonox, which she self-administered, and her pain has gone from 6 out of 10 to 3 out of 10. Distal circulation, movement and sensation in the left hand are normal and unchanged. The dog is her son's, is up to date on its vaccinations, and police and animal control have been notified.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 78 岁女性，约 16:00 在拉开儿子的德国牧羊犬与自家小狗时，左前臂被咬伤。伤口包括四处穿刺伤、一处 3 厘米和一处 5 厘米裂伤，以及前臂背侧 6×4 厘米撕脱皮瓣（我已按解剖位复位）；右前臂另有两处浅表皮肤撕裂，左小腿有一处瘀斑。她没有摔倒、头部未受撞击。出血为持续静脉性渗血，经直接加压、加压包扎和抬高患肢后控制，此后敷料一直保持干燥；现场估计失血 200 毫升。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 152/88、脉搏 92 绝对不齐、呼吸 18、SpO2 室内空气 96%、体温 36.6；末组血压 144/84、脉搏 88、SpO2 97%、体温 36.7。既往史为心房颤动、慢性肾病 3 期、高血压、骨关节炎和骨质疏松。用药为阿哌沙班 5 mg 每日两次、美托洛尔、氨氯地平；重要的是她在 15:00 服过 1000 mg 对乙酰氨基酚。青霉素过敏，表现为荨麻疹。破伤风免疫已过期，可能超过十年。镇痛方面：因 15:00 已服药而未给对乙酰氨基酚，因阿哌沙班而未给布洛芬，因肾病而未给甲氧氟烷；我给了 Entonox 由她自行吸入，疼痛已从 6/10 降至 3/10。左手远端循环、活动和感觉正常且无变化。咬人的是她儿子的狗，疫苗齐全，警方和动物管理部门均已获通知。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Multiple dog bite wounds and an avulsed skin flap to the left forearm in an anticoagulated 78-year-old
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Bitten at approximately 1600 by the son's German Shepherd while separating it from her own dog; provoked, known vaccinated animal; no fall, no head strike; pain 6/10 throbbing, worse dependent; approximately 200 mL blood loss on scene
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Atrial fibrillation, chronic kidney disease stage 3, hypertension, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis; tetanus out of date (over 10 years)
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Apixaban 5 mg BID, metoprolol, amlodipine; acetaminophen 1000 mg PO taken at 1500
pcrKeyPoints.allergies: Penicillin (hives) - relevant to bite antibiotic choice
treatments: Scene entered only after both dogs confirmed secured behind closed doors
Direct pressure over gauze, pressure dressing and elevation - no tourniquet indicated
Sterile saline irrigation; avulsed flap replaced anatomically; non-adherent sterile dressings secured with tubular bandage, no tape on fragile skin
Cold applied with distal circulation confirmed intact; limb elevated
Acetaminophen withheld (1000 mg at 1500, inside 4 hours); ibuprofen withheld (apixaban); methoxyflurane withheld (chronic kidney disease)
Entonox self-administered with cylinder inverted three times and area ventilated; pain 6/10 to 3/10
Consent obtained after explaining infection, bleeding and tetanus risk; bite reported to police and animal control
findings: Four punctures, 3 cm and 5 cm lacerations, 6 x 4 cm viable avulsed flap left forearm; two skin tears right forearm; left shin bruise
Bleeding venous and controllable; dressing dry with no strike-through through transport
Pulse irregularly irregular consistent with chronic atrial fibrillation; stable vitals throughout
Distal circulation, movement and sensation intact in the left hand before and after dressing
No unstable criteria met - non-priority transport
